nodes.name: WebDriverUserPrompt

nodes.name: WebDriverUserPromptAction
nodes.summary: Enum of WebDriver prompt handling actions: Accept, Dismiss, Ignore with string parsing.

nodes.name: WebDriverCommandMsg
nodes.summary: Large enum of all WebDriver commands sent to the constellation: window management, navigation, input, screenshot, cookie, and browsing context operations.

nodes.name: WebDriverScriptCommand
nodes.summary: Very large enum of script-level WebDriver commands including element finding (CSS, XPath, link text, tag name, shadow DOM), cookie management, attribute/property access, scrolling, and load status tracking.
nodes.languageNotes: 44+ variants covering the full WebDriver element interaction and DOM inspection protocol.

nodes.name: WebDriverFrameId
nodes.summary: Enum for identifying frames by either a short index or a DOM element string.

nodes.name: WebDriverLoadStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of WebDriver navigation load states: NavigationStart, NavigationStop, Complete, Timeout, Blocked.

nodes.name: WebDriverSenders
nodes.summary: Collection of senders for asynchronous WebDriver communication: load status senders, script evaluation interrupt sender, and pending traversal senders.

nodes.name: layout_damage.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the LayoutDamage bitflag type and conversion functions between RestyleDamage and LayoutDamage, extending stylo's damage tracking with layout-specific damage modes for the Servo layout system.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses bitflags crate to define LayoutDamage as a superset of RestyleDamage with layout-specific bits for inline content sizes, box damage, and descendant tracking.

nodes.name: layout_dom.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the LayoutDomTypeBundle trait and associated type aliases that map DOM node types to their concrete layout implementations, enabling parameterization of the Layout trait over a single type bundle.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses associated types to bundle multiple concrete layout trait implementations, with type aliases for extraction pending default associated types stabilization.

nodes.name: layout_element.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the LayoutElement trait providing element-level layout operations including style access, attribute retrieval, pseudo-element chain management, and type identification, along with the DangerousStyleElement trait for stylo integration.

nodes.name: LayoutElement
nodes.summary: Core trait exposing DOM elements to layout, providing methods for pseudo-element management, style data access, attribute retrieval, element type identification, and shadow DOM detection, with thread-safety constraints that forbid parent access.

nodes.name: layout_node.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the LayoutNode trait providing comprehensive node-level layout operations including children traversal, style resolution, selection state, image/media/canvas/SVG data access, and table span information for the Servo layout tree.

nodes.name: LayoutNode
nodes.summary: Central layout trait exposing DOM nodes to the layout system, providing flat tree and DOM children traversal, style resolution (own, parent, selected), text content, selection state, image/media/canvas/SVG data, iframe identifiers, table spans, and form input detection.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Core re-export crate for the shared layout module, defining the central Layout trait, factory traits, reflow request/result types, data structures for media/SVG/canvas content, image animation state management, query message types, and geometry types used throughout the Servo layout system.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust library crate root that re-exports all submodules and defines the core trait APIs for the layout system, enabling script and layout threads to communicate through a shared type system.

nodes.name: Layout
nodes.summary: Core trait defining the complete layout engine interface, including stylesheet management, reflow execution, scroll offset handling, display list tracking, DOM query methods (containing blocks, box areas, resolved styles, text indices, elements from point), and accessibility state management.

nodes.name: LayoutConfig
nodes.summary: Data struct holding all configuration needed to initialize a layout thread, including pipeline ID, URL, script communication channel, image cache, font context, viewport details, user stylesheets, theme, and the embedder channel.

nodes.name: ReflowRequest
nodes.summary: Data struct encapsulating all parameters needed to trigger a reflow, including the document, epoch, restyle information, viewport details, reflow goal, animation timeline value, pending animations, and accessibility root nodes.

nodes.name: QueryMsg
nodes.summary: Enum defining all query message variants that script can send to the layout thread, including box area queries, client rect queries, CSS zoom queries, offset parent queries, resolved style queries, scrolling area queries, text index queries, and elements-from-point queries.

nodes.name: LayoutElementType
nodes.summary: Enum classifying all supported HTML and SVG element types for layout purposes, including body, br, canvas, html, iframe, image, input, media, object, select, table elements, textarea, and SVG image/svg elements.

nodes.name: ImageAnimationState
nodes.summary: Tracks the animation state of a single animated image, including the current active frame, frame timing, completed loops count, and methods for advancing frames based on animation timeline values.

nodes.name: AnimatingImages
nodes.summary: Collection managing all currently animating images in the layout, mapping nodes to their ImageAnimationState, with methods for inserting or updating states, removing nodes, clearing dirty flags, and checking emptiness.

nodes.name: ratio_from_view_box
nodes.summary: Parses SVG viewBox attribute string to extract width and height values, computing a width-to-height aspect ratio for SVG element sizing.

nodes.name: update_frame_for_animation_timeline_value
nodes.summary: Advances the active frame of an animated image based on a given animation timeline value, handling frame delays, loop completion, and detection of finished animations.

nodes.name: pseudo_element_chain.rs
nodes.summary: Defines PseudoElementChain, a two-level nested pseudo-element chain data structure supporting before/after pseudo-element nesting rules with operations for adding, removing, and inspecting pseudo-elements.

nodes.name: PseudoElementChain
nodes.summary: Data structure representing a chain of up to two nested pseudo-elements (primary and secondary), supporting before/after pseudo-element nesting rules with methods for creation, inspection, and manipulation.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the WebGL component, declaring submodules and re-exporting WebGLComm for the in-process WebGL communication channel.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust crate root using mod declarations and pub use re-exports.

nodes.name: webgl_limits.rs
nodes.summary: Detects hardware-specific WebGL limits and provides a GLExt trait with safe wrapper methods for querying GL integer, float, and signed integer parameters.

nodes.name: inprocess.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the in-process WebGL communication channel, creating WebGLThread instances and managing swap chains, busy context maps, and WebXR layer grand managers.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module that declares the inprocess submodule and re-exports WebGLComm as the public WebGL communication interface.

nodes.name: webgl_thread.rs
nodes.summary: Core WebGL implementation containing the WebGLThread event loop, WebGLImpl command dispatcher (1467 lines mapping WebGLCommand to glow calls), context lifecycle management, and pixel/format conversion utilities.
nodes.languageNotes: Large Rust file with heavily pattern-matched WebGL command dispatch, conditional WebXR support, and surfman-based context lifecycle.

nodes.name: webxr.rs
nodes.summary: WebXR bridge providing layer manager creation, frame lifecycle (begin/end), and layer management for WebXR sessions via channel-based communication with the WebGL thread.

nodes.name: GLLimitsDetect
nodes.summary: Trait defining the detect method for querying hardware WebGL limits (max textures, buffers, viewport dimensions, etc.) from a glow GL context.

nodes.name: GLExt
nodes.summary: Extension trait on glow::Context providing safe typed getter methods (get_integer, get_integer64, get_float, get_signed_integer) with try_ variants that return Option.

nodes.name: GLLimitsDetect::detect
nodes.summary: Queries 50+ GL parameters to populate a GLLimits struct including max vertex attributes, texture sizes, varying vectors, draw buffers, and timing information.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses glow's get_integer/get_float API with try variants for optional GL features.

nodes.name: try_gl_parameter
nodes.summary: Generic helper that invokes a GL parameter query and returns None if GL error is set, providing safe fallible parameter reading.

nodes.name: WebGLComm
nodes.summary: Holds the WebGLThread pool handle, swap chains, busy context map, and optional WebXR layer grand manager for coordinating in-process WebGL rendering.

nodes.name: WebGLComm::new
nodes.summary: Constructs the WebGL communication channel, creates swap chains, initializes the WebXR bridge, spawns the WebGL thread, and assembles the WebGLThreads handle.

nodes.name: GLState
nodes.summary: Tracks the invariant state of the GL context including color/depth/stencil write masks, clear values, scissor state, and default VAO for restoring state across context switches.

nodes.name: GLContextData
nodes.summary: Per-context data structure holding the surfman Context, glow GL instance, device reference, current state, and attributes for a single WebGL context.

nodes.name: WebGLThread
nodes.summary: Core event loop struct that receives WebGLMsg commands from the DOM thread and dispatches them to WebGLImpl::apply, managing context creation, resize, swap buffers, and WebXR bridge operations.

nodes.name: WebGLThreadInit
nodes.summary: Initialization parameters bundle for creating a WebGLThread, containing paint API, external image manager, channels, swap chains, and optional WebXR bridge init.

nodes.name: WebGLImpl
nodes.summary: WebGL command implementation struct carrying the apply method that dispatches every WebGLCommand variant (200+) to corresponding glow GL calls, managing buffers, textures, shaders, programs, FBOs, uniforms, and transform feedback.
nodes.languageNotes: Single massive apply method dispatching every WebGL spec command via match on WebGLCommand enum variants.

nodes.name: FramebufferRebindingInfo
nodes.summary: Helper struct that detects and reapplies framebuffer bindings after context surface operations like resize or swap buffers.

nodes.name: WebGLThread::new
nodes.summary: Initializes the WebGLThread from WebGLThreadInit, setting up empty device map and context map, and conditionally creating a WebXRBridge.

nodes.name: WebGLThread::run_on_own_thread
nodes.summary: Spawns a dedicated OS thread named 'WebGL' that creates a WebGLThread instance and enters its message processing loop.

nodes.name: WebGLThread::handle_msg
nodes.summary: Routes incoming WebGLMsg variants to the appropriate handler -- context creation, resize, removal, commands, WebXR commands, swap buffers, and cleanup.

nodes.name: WebGLThread::create_webgl_context
nodes.summary: Creates a new WebGL context via surfman: configures context descriptor, creates surface, binds to context, makes current, detects GL limits, initializes framebuffers and state, and registers the context.

nodes.name: WebGLThread::handle_webgl_command
nodes.summary: Looks up the device for a context, makes it current if needed, and delegates to WebGLImpl::apply for command execution.

nodes.name: WebGLThread::handle_webxr_command
nodes.summary: Dispatches WebXR commands (create/destroy layer manager, create/destroy layer, begin/end frame) to the WebXRBridge instance.

nodes.name: WebGLThread::handle_swap_buffers
nodes.summary: Handles buffer swap for one or more context IDs, including framebuffer rebinding detection, surface clearing, swap chain operations, and webrender image updates.

nodes.name: WebGLThread::resize_webgl_context
nodes.summary: Resizes a WebGL context's surface, handles framebuffer rebinding, clears the surface with the current color, and updates the webrender image.

nodes.name: WebGLThread::remove_webgl_context
nodes.summary: Removes a WebGL context: clears busy state, destroys swap chains and surfman context, cleans up webrender images, and destroys any associated WebXR layers.

nodes.name: WebGLImpl::apply
nodes.summary: Massive command dispatcher mapping 200+ WebGLCommand variants to glow GL calls -- buffers, textures, shaders, programs, framebuffers, uniforms, transform feedback, queries, sync objects, and state queries.
nodes.languageNotes: Single match-over-enum pattern with ~200 arms covering the full WebGL 1.0/2.0 API surface.

nodes.name: WebGLImpl::link_program
nodes.summary: Links a GL program and returns detailed info including active attributes, uniforms, uniform blocks, transform feedback varyings, and atomic counter buffers.

nodes.name: image_to_tex_image_data
nodes.summary: Converts generic image pixel data (bytes, HTML image, ImageData, canvas) into the correct GL texel format, handling format conversion, alpha premultiplication, and Y-axis flipping.

nodes.name: prepare_pixels
nodes.summary: Prepares pixel data for GL upload by applying alpha treatment and Y-axis flipping according to the specified pixel format and unpacking alignment.

nodes.name: WebGLThread::get_or_create_device_for_painter
nodes.summary: Retrieves or lazily creates a surfman Device for a given painter, caching it in the device map for reuse.

nodes.name: WebGLThread::make_current_if_needed
nodes.summary: Makes a context current on the GL thread if it is not already bound, returning access to GLContextData or None.

nodes.name: WebGLThread::update_webrender_image_for_context
nodes.summary: Updates the webrender image for a context by extracting external image data and pushing it to the paint API for compositing.

nodes.name: WebXRBridge
nodes.summary: Bridge between WebGL and WebXR that receives layer manager factory instances and manages XR layer managers, supporting create/destroy/begin-frame/end-frame lifecycle.

nodes.name: WebXRBridgeInit
nodes.summary: Initialization data for WebXRBridge containing a sender channel and factory communication channels for creating WebXR layer managers.

nodes.name: WebXRBridgeGrandManager
nodes.summary: Top-level WebXR grand manager that creates child layer managers by sending factory requests through channels to the WebXRBridge running in the WebGL thread.

nodes.name: WebXRBridgeManager
nodes.summary: Per-instance WebXR layer manager that creates, destroys, and manages individual WebXR layers and their frame lifecycle (begin/end) via channel messages to the WebGL thread.

nodes.name: WebXRBridge::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new WebXRBridge with an empty managers map and the initial manager ID set to the minimum non-zero value.

nodes.name: WebXRBridgeInit::new
nodes.summary: Creates a WebXRBridgeInit with unbounded channels for factory communication and the given sender for WebGL message routing.

nodes.name: WebXRBridge::create_layer_manager
nodes.summary: Receives a layer manager factory from the channel, builds the manager, assigns an ID, and stores it in the managers map.

nodes.name: WebXRBridge::destroy_layer_manager
nodes.summary: Removes a layer manager from the internal map, cleaning up its resources.

nodes.name: WebXRBridge::create_layer
nodes.summary: Delegates layer creation to the identified manager with the given contexts, context ID, and layer initialization data.

nodes.name: WebXRBridge::destroy_layer
nodes.summary: Delegates layer destruction to the identified manager for the specified context and layer ID.

nodes.name: WebXRBridge::destroy_all_layers
nodes.summary: Destroys all layers across all managers for a given context, collecting layer IDs and removing each one.

nodes.name: WebXRBridge::begin_frame
nodes.summary: Begins a new WebXR frame for the identified manager, providing the contexts and layer list.

nodes.name: WebXRBridge::end_frame
nodes.summary: Ends the current WebXR frame for the identified manager, completing the frame lifecycle.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module declaration file that re-exports all URL-related DOM types (URL, UrlHelper, URLPattern, URLSearchParams) from submodules.

nodes.name: url.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the DOM URL API with constructor, parsing, serialization, and getter/setter accessors for all URL components, delegating most component access to UrlHelper.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the Servo DOM object model with reflect_dom_object, DomRefCell for interior mutability, and delegates URL component access to the UrlHelper utility module.

nodes.name: urlhelper.rs
nodes.summary: Provides stateless getter/setter utility functions for all URL components (hash, host, hostname, href, origin, password, pathname, port, protocol, search, username) via the Servo URL quirks module.

nodes.name: urlpattern.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the DOM URLPattern API for URL pattern matching with test() and exec() operations and component-level getters.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps the urlpattern crate's UrlPattern type via Servo's bindings_to_third_party and third_party_to_bindings conversion layers.

nodes.name: urlsearchparams.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the DOM URLSearchParams API for URL query string manipulation, supporting append, delete, get, getAll, has, set, sort, and serialization operations.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses form_urlencoded for parsing and serializing query strings, with a DomRefCell-backed list of (name, value) pairs and callbacks to update the associated URL.

nodes.name: URL
nodes.summary: DOM API representation of a URL with accessors for all URL components and static methods for URL parsing, object URL creation, and revocation.

nodes.name: UrlHelper
nodes.summary: Namespace struct hosting public getter/setter utility functions that delegate to the Servo URL quirks module methods for each URL component.

nodes.name: URLPattern
nodes.summary: DOM API wrapper around the urlpattern crate's UrlPattern, providing pattern-based URL matching via test() and exec(), plus component-level accessor properties.

nodes.name: URLSearchParams
nodes.summary: DOM API wrapper for URL query string manipulation, maintaining a list of name-value pairs with full CRUD operations, sorting, and serialization.

nodes.name: query_pairs
nodes.summary: Returns the URL's query string parsed into a vector of (name, value) string pairs.

nodes.name: set_query_pairs
nodes.summary: Sets the URL's query string from a vector of (name, value) pairs, clearing and rebuilding the query component.

nodes.name: unicode_serialization_blob_url
nodes.summary: Constructs a blob URL string from an origin and ID, producing the 'blob:{origin}/{id}' serialization format.

nodes.summary: DOM URL constructor that parses a URL string with an optional base URL, returning a new URL DOM object or throwing on invalid input.

nodes.name: Parse
nodes.summary: Static URL parsing method that returns a new URL DOM object from a URL string and optional base, used when the constructor cannot be called directly.

nodes.name: RevokeObjectURL
nodes.summary: Revokes an object URL by communicating with the file manager thread to release the associated blob resources.

nodes.name: SetHref
nodes.summary: Set the entire URL from a string, re-parsing the URL and updating the internal URL state and search params.

nodes.name: run_api_url_parser
nodes.summary: Internal URL parser using the url crate with optional base URL resolution, returning a parsed Url or an error.

nodes.name: initialize
nodes.summary: Initializes a URLPattern from the given input, base URL, and options, parsing the pattern through the urlpattern crate and setting up the DOM wrapper.

nodes.name: Constructor
nodes.summary: DOM URLPattern constructor accepting input, base URL, and options, delegating to the initialize method.

nodes.name: Constructor_
nodes.summary: Alternate DOM URLPattern constructor accepting input and options without a base URL, delegating to the initialize method.

nodes.name: Test
nodes.summary: Tests whether an input URL matches the URL pattern, processing the match input and returning a boolean.

nodes.name: Exec
nodes.summary: Executes pattern matching on an input URL and returns the matched component results including protocol, hostname, pathname, search, hash, and their capturing groups.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new URLSearchParams DOM object without a prototype, delegating to new_with_proto with None for the proto.

nodes.name: new_with_proto
nodes.summary: Creates a new URLSearchParams DOM object with an optional prototype, initializing the list from the URL's query pairs and wrapping it as a DOM object.

nodes.name: Constructor
nodes.summary: DOM URLSearchParams constructor accepting a sequence, record, or USVString initializer, parsing pairs and populating the internal list.

nodes.name: GetAll
nodes.summary: Returns all values associated with a given query parameter name as a sequence of USVStrings.

nodes.name: Set
nodes.summary: Sets a query parameter's value, replacing all existing values for that name with a single value, or appending if the name does not exist.

nodes.name: serialize_utf8
nodes.summary: Serializes the query parameter list to a URL-encoded query string using form_urlencoded serialization.

nodes.name: mod.rs

nodes.name: paintsize.rs

nodes.name: PaintSize
nodes.summary: DOM-accessible struct representing paint worklet dimensions with width and height properties available to the JavaScript paint callback.

nodes.name: PaintSize::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a PaintSize DOM object from a CSS pixel size, reflecting it into the JS heap via the script bindings reflector.

nodes.name: paintworkletglobalscope.rs
nodes.summary: Implements PaintWorkletGlobalScope for the CSS Paint API, managing paint definitions, class instances, image caching, and paint callback invocation with speculative rendering support.

nodes.name: PaintWorkletGlobalScope
nodes.summary: Global execution scope for CSS Paint API worklets, storing paint definitions, cached paint class instances, and the most recent paint results for cache-hit optimization.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a multi-level cache (name, size, DPR, properties, arguments) to avoid re-invoking JS paint callbacks on repeated draws.

nodes.name: PaintWorkletTask
nodes.summary: Enumeration of paint worklet tasks: drawing a paint image with all parameters, and speculative drawing for pre-computation.

nodes.name: PaintWorkletGlobalScope::new
nodes.summary: Creates a new PaintWorkletGlobalScope with inherited WorkletGlobalScope fields, image cache, empty paint definitions, and initial cached values.

nodes.name: perform_a_worklet_task
nodes.summary: Dispatches paint worklet tasks with result caching: returns cached result on parameter match or delegates to draw_a_paint_image and updates cache on miss.

nodes.name: draw_a_paint_image
nodes.summary: Converts CSS pixel size to device pixels and delegates to invoke_a_paint_callback to execute the registered JS paint function.

nodes.name: invoke_a_paint_callback
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the full paint callback lifecycle: retrieves the paint class constructor, creates paint instances, builds argument objects (rendering context, paint size, properties, input arguments), calls the JS paint function, and handles exceptions.

nodes.name: invalid_image

nodes.name: PaintDefinition::new
nodes.summary: Allocates a PaintDefinition with JS heap values for class constructor and paint function, plus alpha flag, input arguments length, and rendering context reference.

nodes.name: worklet.rs

nodes.languageNotes: Uses a custom three-thread pool with atomic role swapping to guarantee deadlock-free worklet execution, inspired by Servo's parallel architecture.

nodes.name: Worklet
nodes.summary: DOM interface for the Houdini Worklet object, managing module loading via addModule() and delegating execution to the WorkletThreadPool.

nodes.name: WorkletId
nodes.summary: Unique worklet identifier wrapping a UUID v4 value, used to track global scopes across the thread pool.

nodes.name: PendingTasksStruct
nodes.summary: Atomic reference-counted counter tracking pending script-loading tasks across worklet threads, used to resolve or reject the module-loading promise.

nodes.name: WorkletThreadPool
nodes.summary: Three-thread pool with primary, hot backup, and cold backup roles ensuring responsive worklet execution, GC offloading, and script loading without blocking the primary thread.

nodes.name: WorkletThread
nodes.summary: Individual worklet thread with its own JS runtime, role-aware message loop, global scope registry, and memory-pressure-triggered GC scheduling.

nodes.name: WorkletExecutor
nodes.summary: Clonable executor that schedules worklet tasks by sending them to the primary worklet thread via crossbeam channel.

nodes.name: Worklet::new
nodes.summary: Creates a new Worklet DOM object with a Window reference and WorkletGlobalScopeType, reflected into the JS context via reflect_dom_object_with_cx.

nodes.name: Worklet::AddModule
nodes.summary: Implements addModule(): parses the module URL, initializes the thread pool, creates a pending tasks counter, and fetches/invokes the worklet script on all threads via the WorkletThreadPool.

nodes.name: WorkletThreadPool::spawn
nodes.summary: Creates three WorkletThreadRole instances (primary, hot backup, cold backup) and spawns three WorkletThreads, returning the WorkletThreadPool with all channel senders.

nodes.name: WorkletThreadPool::fetch_and_invoke_a_worklet_script
nodes.summary: Sends a FetchAndInvokeAWorkletScript control message to all three worklet threads with pipeline context, script URL, credentials, and promise, then wakes the threads.

nodes.name: WorkletThreadPool::exit_worklet
nodes.summary: Sends an ExitWorklet control message to all three worklet threads, triggering cleanup of the associated global scope.

nodes.name: WorkletThread::spawn
nodes.summary: Spawns a named OS thread for a worklet role, initializes the JS runtime, creates the WorkletThread state, and enters the main event loop.

nodes.name: WorkletThread::run
nodes.summary: Main event loop processing data messages (worklet tasks, role swaps, wake, quit) and control messages, with GC scheduling and dynamic role reassignment when memory pressure is detected.

nodes.name: WorkletThread::gc
nodes.summary: Triggers JavaScript GC via the SpiderMonkey API and adjusts the GC threshold to double the current memory usage, preventing tight GC loops.

nodes.name: WorkletThread::get_worklet_global_scope
nodes.summary: Retrieves an existing WorkletGlobalScope by worklet ID from the thread's hash map, or creates a new one via WorkletGlobalScope::new and caches it.

nodes.name: WorkletThread::fetch_and_invoke_a_worklet_script
nodes.summary: Fetches a worklet module script via the resource thread, evaluates it in the worklet global scope's JS context, and resolves or rejects the promise based on success or failure.

nodes.name: WorkletThread::process_control
nodes.summary: Dispatches control messages: removes global scopes on ExitWorklet, or creates the scope and fetches the script on FetchAndInvokeAWorkletScript.

nodes.name: WorkletThread::run_in_script_thread
nodes.summary: Sends a task closure to the main script thread via the CommonScriptMsg channel for cross-thread promise resolution or rejection.

nodes.name: WorkletExecutor::schedule_a_worklet_task
nodes.summary: Sends a worklet task to the primary worklet thread via the crossbeam channel for execution by the thread pool.

nodes.name: workletglobalscope.rs

nodes.name: WorkletGlobalScope

nodes.name: WorkletGlobalScopeInit
nodes.summary: Initialization bundle holding all channels and resources (script thread sender, resource threads, profilers, image cache, constellation sender) required to bootstrap a worklet global scope.

nodes.name: WorkletGlobalScopeType
nodes.summary: Enumeration of worklet global scope types, currently Paint and optionally Test behind the testbinding feature gate.

nodes.name: WorkletTask
nodes.summary: Enumeration of worklet tasks that can be dispatched to a worklet global scope: Test and Paint variants.

nodes.name: WorkletGlobalScope::new

nodes.name: WorkletGlobalScope::new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates a stack-allocated WorkletGlobalScope by initializing a GlobalScope and setting base URL, script thread sender, executor, pipeline ID, and a new opaque origin.

nodes.name: WorkletGlobalScope::evaluate_js
nodes.summary: Enters the worklet's JS realm and evaluates JavaScript source code on the global scope with WORKLET introduction type.

nodes.name: WorkletGlobalScope::register_paint_worklet
nodes.summary: Sends a RegisterPaintWorklet message to the main script thread with the paint name, input properties, and boxed Painter for layout-side paint registration.

nodes.name: WorkletGlobalScope::perform_a_worklet_task
nodes.summary: Dispatches worklet tasks to the appropriate specialized global scope (Paint or Test) via downcasting from the base WorkletGlobalScope type.

nodes.name: font_descriptor.rs

nodes.name: FontDescriptor
nodes.summary: Describes the rendering parameters of a specific font instance, including weight, stretch, style, point size, variation settings, synthesis, and optical sizing.

nodes.name: CSSFontFaceDescriptors
nodes.summary: Represents optional CSS @font-face descriptors including family name, weight/stretch/style ranges, and unicode-range for font selection.

nodes.name: LowercaseFontFamilyName
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper around a case-normalized (lowercased) font family name string for consistent matching.

nodes.name: with_variation_settings
nodes.summary: Returns a new FontDescriptor with the given variation settings applied, cloning other parameters.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a CSSFontFaceDescriptors from a family name string with default values for all optional descriptors.

nodes.name: FontIdentifier
nodes.summary: Enum identifying a font source: Local (platform-specific path identifier), Web (URL from @font-face src), or ArrayBuffer (JavaScript API). Dispatches to platform-specific index and handle resolution.

nodes.name: index
nodes.summary: Returns the face index for the font: delegates to platform-specific LocalFontIdentifier for local fonts, or returns 0 for web and array buffer fonts.

nodes.name: FontTemplateRef
nodes.summary: A reference-counted, atomically-refcell-guarded handle to a FontTemplate enabling shared ownership and interior mutability.

nodes.name: FontTemplateDescriptor
nodes.summary: Describes the inherent font properties (weight/stretch/style ranges and unicode coverage) used in the CSS font matching algorithm.

nodes.name: FontTemplate
nodes.summary: Core font template holding the FontIdentifier, FontTemplateDescriptor, and optional @font-face rule reference needed to create font instances.

nodes.name: FontTemplateRefMethods
nodes.summary: Trait providing ergonomic accessors on FontTemplateRef for descriptor, identifier, font matching, unicode-range checking, and @font-face rule retrieval.

nodes.name: FontMatchDistanceMethod
nodes.summary: Trait defining the match_distance and to_float methods used by FontStretch, FontWeight, and FontStyle to compute CSS font matching distances.

nodes.name: IsOblique
nodes.summary: Trait with a single is_oblique method to distinguish oblique font styles from normal and italic.

nodes.name: FontTemplateRef::new
nodes.summary: Creates a new FontTemplateRef wrapping the given FontTemplate in Arc<AtomicRefCell>.

nodes.name: FontTemplateDescriptor::new
nodes.summary: Creates a FontTemplateDescriptor with the given weight, stretch, and style values set as single-point ranges with no unicode-range.

nodes.name: FontTemplate::new
nodes.summary: Creates a new FontTemplate from a FontIdentifier, FontTemplateDescriptor, and optional @font-face rule descriptors.

nodes.name: new_for_local_web_font
nodes.summary: Creates a FontTemplate for a local() src font-face rule by cloning the local template and overriding its descriptor with CSS @font-face properties.

nodes.name: identifier
nodes.summary: Returns a reference to the FontTemplate's FontIdentifier.

nodes.name: compute_variations
nodes.summary: Computes the complete list of OpenType font variations by merging font-variation-settings, @font-face variation settings, and implied axes (wght, wdth, opsz) per the CSS Fonts Level 4 specification.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the CSS font-variation-settings cascade with ascending precedence order, deduplicating by tag.

nodes.name: is_defined_by_font_face_rule
nodes.summary: Checks whether this FontTemplate was defined by the given @font-face rule by comparing rule references.

nodes.name: override_values_with_css_font_template_descriptors
nodes.summary: Overrides the FontTemplateDescriptor's weight, stretch, style, and unicode-range with values from CSS @font-face descriptors, supporting italic and oblique angle ranges.

nodes.name: is_variation_font
nodes.summary: Returns true if the font descriptor has non-zero range spans for weight, stretch, or style, indicating a variable font.

nodes.name: distance_from
nodes.summary: Computes a weighted distance score between this descriptor and a target FontDescriptor for font matching, with stretch weighted highest followed by style and weight.

nodes.name: FontStretch::match_distance
nodes.summary: Calculates font stretch matching distance with reverse direction penalties, preferring larger values above normal and smaller values below.

nodes.name: FontWeight::match_distance
nodes.summary: Implements CSS font-weight matching distance with special handling for the 400-500 range where weights first search upward before downward.

nodes.name: FontStyle::match_distance
nodes.summary: Implements CSS font-style matching distance for normal, italic, and oblique angles, with direction-dependent penalties for non-preferred search directions and sign-crossing biases.
nodes.languageNotes: Port of Gecko's font matching with 150+ lines handling 8 distinct oblique angle cases and reverse/negate bias constants.

nodes.name: ByteIndex
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper around usize representing a byte offset in a text run, with NumOps derive for arithmetic operations.

nodes.name: TextByteRange
nodes.summary: A range of UTF-8 byte positions in a text run, used to identify glyphs by their original character offsets. Implements Iterator and DoubleEndedIterator for iteration over byte positions.

nodes.name: FontData
nodes.summary: Stores raw font file data in an Arc<GenericSharedMemory> for zero-copy IPC transport across process boundaries.

nodes.name: FontDataAndIndex
nodes.summary: Pairs raw font data with its face index within a TrueType Collection (TTC) file, or 0 for single-font files.

nodes.name: FontDataError
nodes.summary: Simple enum indicating font data loading failure.

nodes.name: intersect
nodes.summary: Computes the intersection of two TextByteRanges, returning an empty default range when they do not overlap.

nodes.name: next
nodes.summary: Advances the TextByteRange iterator forward by one byte, yielding the next ByteIndex.

nodes.name: next_back
nodes.summary: Advances the TextByteRange iterator backward by one byte, yielding the previous ByteIndex for reverse iteration.

nodes.name: from_bytes
nodes.summary: Creates a FontData instance from a byte slice, wrapping it in GenericSharedMemory for IPC compatibility.

nodes.name: as_ipc_shared_memory
nodes.summary: Returns a clone of the underlying Arc<GenericSharedMemory> for sending font data across IPC channels.

nodes.name: SystemFontServiceMessage
nodes.summary: Enum defining the IPC message protocol between FontContext and SystemFontService, including font template lookup, font instance creation, key generation, and memory reporting.

nodes.name: SystemFontServiceProxySender
nodes.summary: Clonable sender wrapper that can create new SystemFontServiceProxy instances with a shared IPC channel.

nodes.name: SystemFontServiceProxy
nodes.summary: Public interface for FontContext instances to communicate with the SystemFontService via IPC, with an RwLock-protected cache for font template query results.

nodes.name: to_proxy
nodes.summary: Constructs a new SystemFontServiceProxy from a proxy sender by cloning the IPC sender and initializing an empty template cache.

nodes.name: exit
nodes.summary: Sends an Exit message to the system font service and waits for acknowledgment, blocking until the service confirms shutdown.

nodes.name: to_sender
nodes.summary: Creates a new SystemFontServiceProxySender by cloning the underlying IPC sender.

nodes.name: get_system_font_instance
nodes.summary: Requests a system font instance from the font service via IPC for a given font identifier, size, flags, and variations, with connection-liveness checking on failure.

nodes.name: find_matching_font_templates
nodes.summary: Looks up font templates matching a descriptor and family, checking an RwLock-protected cache first before querying the system font service via IPC and caching results.

nodes.name: generate_font_key
nodes.summary: Generates a unique WebRender FontKey for a painter via IPC communication with the system font service.

nodes.name: generate_font_instance_key
nodes.summary: Generates a unique WebRender FontInstanceKey for a painter via IPC communication with the system font service.

nodes.name: prefetch_font_keys_for_painter
nodes.summary: Sends a prefetch hint to the system font service to eagerly allocate font keys for a given painter.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Root module of the config crate that exposes the opts, pref_util, and prefs modules, providing compile-time and runtime configuration mechanisms for the Servo engine.

nodes.name: opts.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Opts struct for global immutable configuration flags, along with the DiagnosticsLogging system and related types for controlling debug diagnostics output at startup.

nodes.name: pref_util.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the PrefValue enum representing typed preference values (Float, Int, UInt, Str, Bool, Array) with JSON serialization and string parsing with type auto-detection.

nodes.name: prefs.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the runtime-changeable Preferences struct with ~150 preference fields, an observer notification system, and UserAgentPlatform logic for constructing platform-specific user-agent strings.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust RwLock-based global state pattern with observer notification and Stylo static pref bridge for layout engine preferences.

nodes.name: Opts
nodes.summary: Global immutable configuration options for Servo, including profiler settings, debug diagnostics, sandbox mode, network certificate handling, and multiprocess mode flags.

nodes.name: DiagnosticsLoggingOption
nodes.summary: Enumeration of debug diagnostic options including style tree, rule tree, display list, scroll tree, and accessibility tree logging that can be enabled via command-line flags.

nodes.name: DiagnosticsLogging
nodes.summary: Runtime configuration for Servo's debug diagnostic logging with per-option enable/disable and comma-separated string-based configuration parsing from the SERVO_DIAGNOSTICS environment variable.

nodes.name: OutputOptions
nodes.summary: Enum representing output destinations for the time profiler, either writing to a named file or printing to stdout at a specified interval in seconds.

nodes.name: PrefValue
nodes.summary: Typed enum representing preference values (Float, Int, UInt, Str, Bool, Array) with conversion from JSON values, string parsing, and conversions to/from Rust primitive types.

nodes.name: PreferencesObserver
nodes.summary: Trait for components that wish to receive notifications when global preferences are changed at runtime.

nodes.name: Preferences
nodes.summary: Large struct containing all ~150 runtime-changeable preferences for Servo covering DOM features, JavaScript engine, layout, networking, graphics, and accessibility settings.

nodes.name: UserAgentPlatform
nodes.summary: Enum of supported user-agent platforms (Desktop, Android, OpenHarmony, Ios) with platform-aware User-Agent string generation.

nodes.name: help_option
nodes.summary: Returns the string representation of a diagnostics logging option suitable for command-line arguments.

nodes.name: help_message
nodes.summary: Returns a short description of the diagnostic option for use in command-line help text.

nodes.name: iter
nodes.summary: Returns an iterator over all variants of DiagnosticsLoggingOption for enumeration purposes.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new DiagnosticsLogging configuration, automatically reading and parsing the SERVO_DIAGNOSTICS environment variable in debug builds.

nodes.name: toggle_option
nodes.summary: Enables or disables a specific diagnostics logging option by index.

nodes.name: is_enabled
nodes.summary: Returns whether a specific diagnostics logging option is currently enabled.

nodes.name: extend_from_string
nodes.summary: Parses a comma-separated string of diagnostic option names and enables matching options in the current DiagnosticsLogging configuration.

nodes.name: default
nodes.summary: Provides default values for all Opts fields with debug, profiler, sandbox, and multiprocess features disabled by default.

nodes.name: initialize_options
nodes.summary: One-time initialization of the global Opts singleton, panicking if called more than once.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Returns the global Opts singleton via OnceLock, initializing to defaults if not yet explicitly set via initialize_options.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses std::sync::OnceLock for safe global mutable singleton with lazy initialization.

nodes.name: test_parsing_of_diagnostics_logging_options
nodes.summary: Tests parsing of diagnostic logging option strings, verifying round-trip conversion between string representations and enum variants.

nodes.name: from_booleanish_str
nodes.summary: Parses a string into a PrefValue, recognizing true/false as booleans, numeric strings as integers or floats, and falling back to string values.

nodes.name: try_from
nodes.summary: Converts a serde_json::Value into a PrefValue, handling null (error), booleans, numbers, strings, and arrays with recursive element conversion.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Converts a PrefValue::Array with exactly 4 f64 elements into a fixed-size [f64; 4] array, used for decoding color values from preferences.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Returns a read lock on the global Preferences instance for accessing preference values.

nodes.name: add_observer
nodes.summary: Registers a PreferencesObserver to be notified when global preferences change at runtime.

nodes.name: set
nodes.summary: Updates the global Preferences, computing the diff, synchronizing layout preferences with Stylo via stylo_static_prefs, and notifying all registered observers.

nodes.name: const_default
nodes.summary: Returns a const-compatible Preferences instance with all ~150 preference fields initialized to their compiled default values.

nodes.name: editing_caret_blink_time
nodes.summary: Returns the caret blink duration as an Option<Duration>, returning None if blinking is disabled.

nodes.name: preferences_default (impl Default for Preferences)
nodes.summary: Creates a Preferences instance with defaults, overriding user_agent and proxy settings from environment variables.

nodes.name: user_agent_platform_default (UserAgentPlatform::default)
nodes.summary: Returns the default UserAgentPlatform for the current compilation target using conditional compilation (android, ohos, ios, or desktop).

nodes.name: to_user_agent_string
nodes.summary: Formats a platform-specific User-Agent HTTP header string including Mozilla/5.0 prefix, OS identification, Servo version, and Firefox compatibility identifier.

nodes.name: canvas_context.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the WebGPU canvas context for Servo's parallel browser engine, managing staging buffers, texture presentation, and GPU-to-CPU data transfers via a state-machine lifecycle for buffer allocation and mapping.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust enum-based staging buffer state machine with GPU device interaction through wgpu-core.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the WebGPU component, exposing the start_webgpu_thread function that bootstraps the WGPU worker thread, poll thread, and cross-thread channel infrastructure.

nodes.name: poll_thread.rs
nodes.summary: Dedicated WGPU polling thread that parks when idle and wakes on GPU work submissions, providing token-based work tracking and mutual exclusion for device maintain calls.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses AtomicUsize work counting, thread parking/unparking, and RAII WorkToken for zero-cost idle detection.

nodes.name: wgpu_thread.rs
nodes.summary: Main WGPU backend thread implementing a message-driven WebGPU API surface, dispatching GPU operations including buffer/texture creation, compute and render passes, shader compilation, and error scope management.
nodes.languageNotes: Large message-loop pattern dispatching over 50 wgpu-core operations with deferred resource cleanup and device error scope stacks.

nodes.name: MappedBuffer
nodes.summary: Wraps a mapped GPU buffer with CPU-accessible slice, stride calculation, and image format information for CPU-side pixel data access.

nodes.name: StagingBuffer
nodes.summary: Stateful GPU staging buffer with lifecycle states (Unassigned, Available, Mapping, Mapped) handling buffer creation, texture copy commands, mapping, and snapshot extraction.

nodes.name: WebGpuExternalImages
nodes.summary: Manages a map of WebGPU external images with lock/unlock semantics for presenting canvas content as external texture data to WebRender.

nodes.name: PresentationStagingBuffer
nodes.summary: Holds a presentation frame's staging buffer with epoch tracking, enabling destruction of stale presentations when no longer referenced.

nodes.name: ContextData
nodes.summary: Per-context data tracking image keys, canvas size, staging buffer pool, current presentation, and epoch counter for GPU canvas lifecycle management.

nodes.name: StagingBuffer::ensure_available
nodes.summary: Ensures the staging buffer has a compatible GPU buffer allocated, creating or replacing it via device_create_buffer when the current buffer is mismatched or absent.

nodes.name: StagingBuffer::prepare_load_texture_command_buffer
nodes.summary: Creates and returns a command buffer that copies texture data from a GPU texture into the staging buffer for CPU readback.

nodes.name: StagingBuffer::unmap
nodes.summary: Unmaps the staging buffer and transitions its state back to Available for reuse.

nodes.name: StagingBuffer::snapshot
nodes.summary: Extracts a CPU-side pixel snapshot from the mapped staging buffer, handling stride and padding for row-by-row copying to produce a SharedSnapshot with alpha/format metadata.

nodes.name: StagingBuffer::drop
nodes.summary: Drops the staging buffer by releasing its GPU buffer allocation via buffer_drop.

nodes.name: WebGpuExternalImages::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new WebGpuExternalImages instance wrapping an image map for WebGPU external image management.

nodes.name: WebGpuExternalImages::lock
nodes.summary: Locks a WebGPU context by ID, retrieving its presentation buffer data and returning it as an ExternalImageSource::RawData for WebRender consumption.

nodes.name: WebGpuExternalImages::unlock
nodes.summary: Unlocks a previously locked WebGPU context, destroying stale presentation data and removing the lock tracking entry.

nodes.name: ContextData::new
nodes.summary: Constructs ContextData with a set of pre-allocated staging buffers from given buffer IDs and initializes the epoch counter.

nodes.name: ContextData::get_or_make_available_buffer
nodes.summary: Selects a compatible staging buffer from the inactive pool by checking availability, compatibility, and assignment state, ensuring it is ready for GPU texture download.

nodes.name: ContextData::destroy
nodes.summary: Destroys the canvas context by freeing all staging buffers via the script channel and removing the associated image key from the paint API.

nodes.name: ContextData::replace_presentation
nodes.summary: Replaces the current presentation with a new one at the next epoch, potentially destroying the stale presentation data.

nodes.name: create_context
nodes.summary: Creates a new WebGPU canvas context by constructing ContextData from buffer IDs and inserting it into the shared image map, returning the assigned context ID.

nodes.name: set_image_key
nodes.summary: Associates an ImageKey with a canvas context for WebRender rendering, managing image lifecycle via delete/add operations and serializing the canvas as an external image.

nodes.name: get_image
nodes.summary: Retrieves the current canvas image as a SharedSnapshot, initiating an async GPU texture download when stale and returning either the new snapshot or the most recent presentation data.

nodes.name: present
nodes.summary: Presents the canvas by updating the WebRender image with pending texture data, orchestrating GPU texture downloads, and managing the presentation staging buffer lifecycle.

nodes.name: texture_download
nodes.summary: Performs an async GPU texture-to-buffer copy, mapping the staging buffer upon completion and invoking a callback with the mapped data for further processing.

nodes.name: destroy_context
nodes.summary: Destroys a WebGPU canvas context by removing it from the shared image map and invoking its resource cleanup.

nodes.name: start_webgpu_thread
nodes.summary: Initializes the WGPU thread by setting up bidirectional channels, checking the webgpu preference flag, spawning the dedicated WGPU thread, and returning a WebGPU sender and script receiver pair.

nodes.name: Poller
nodes.summary: Dedicated WGPU poller thread manager that parks when idle, wakes on GPU work submissions, and coordinates device maintain calls via a lock-based workaround for wgpu deadlocks.

nodes.name: WorkToken
nodes.summary: RAII guard that decrements the poller's work counter on drop, signaling that outstanding GPU work has completed.

nodes.name: poll_all_devices
nodes.summary: Polls all WGPU devices under a mutex lock to process pending GPU operations, returning whether queues are empty for the caller to decide on continued polling.

nodes.name: Poller::new
nodes.summary: Spawns the dedicated WGPU poller thread with atomic work counters, starting a polling loop that parks when idle and wakes on work submission.

nodes.name: Poller::token
nodes.summary: Creates a WorkToken that increments the atomic work counter, keeping the poller active until the token is dropped.

nodes.name: Poller::wake
nodes.summary: Unparks the poller thread to trigger immediate device polling when new GPU work is submitted.

nodes.name: Poller::lock
nodes.summary: Acquires the poller's internal mutex lock for coordinating device maintain calls and queue submissions with the polling thread.

nodes.name: DeviceScope
nodes.summary: Per-device scope tracking the pipeline ID, device ID, and error scope stack for WebGPU error scope push/pop operations, becoming None when the device is lost.

nodes.name: WGPU
nodes.summary: Main WGPU backend struct containing the global GPU context, device map, paint API reference, image map, poller, and active compute/render pass collections for message-driven GPU command processing.

nodes.name: DeviceScope::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DeviceScope with a fresh error scope stack for a given device and pipeline ID.

nodes.name: WGPU::new
nodes.summary: Constructs the WGPU backend, initializing the wgpu-core Global instance with configured backends, creating the poller thread, and setting up device and pass collections.

nodes.name: WGPU::run
nodes.summary: Main message loop processing WebGPU API requests from the script thread, dispatching over 50 GPU operations including buffer/texture creation, compute/render passes, shader compilation, adapter enumeration, device creation, and resource cleanup with deferred polling.

nodes.name: dispatch_error
nodes.summary: Dispatches a GPU error to the appropriate error scope in the device's stack, falling back to an uncaptured error message sent to the script thread when no scope matches.

nodes.name: basic.py
nodes.summary: Entry point for the Dartmouth BASIC (1964) interpreter example. Parses command-line arguments to run a BASIC source file or launch an interactive REPL loop using PLY-based lexer, parser, and interpreter components.

nodes.name: basiclex.py
nodes.summary: PLY lexer specification for Dartmouth BASIC. Defines token rules for identifiers, REM statements, NEWLINEs, and error handling using PLY naming conventions for the BASIC example interpreter.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PLY's naming convention where t_NAME functions define token rules and t_error handles illegal characters.

nodes.name: basiclog.py
nodes.summary: Logging-enabled variant of the BASIC interpreter entry point. Configures Python logging for PLY parser debug output, writing parse trace information to a file.

nodes.name: basinterp.py
nodes.summary: Full BASIC interpreter runtime implementing statement execution for Dartmouth BASIC programs. The BasicInterpreter class handles variable assignment, arithmetic expressions, control flow (FOR/NEXT, IF/GOTO), subroutines (GOSUB/RETURN), array operations (DIM), and built-in math functions.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements recursive expression evaluation via self.eval() dispatching on parse tree nodes, mirroring the grammar production rules.

nodes.name: basparse.py
nodes.summary: PLY parser grammar specification for Dartmouth BASIC. Defines production rules for all BASIC statements (LET, PRINT, IF, FOR, GOTO, GOSUB, DIM, READ, DATA, REM, DEF, END, STOP), expressions with binary/unary operators, and variable references with array subscript support.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PLY yacc conventions where p_NAME functions define grammar production rules with documentation strings specifying the grammar.

nodes.name: GardenSnake.py
nodes.summary: Complete Python parser and compiler for a simplified Python-like language built with PLY. Includes an indentation-aware lexer (IndentLexer), full parser grammar for function definitions, if statements, expressions, and AST construction with compilation to Python bytecode.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements indentation-sensitive lexing via INDENT/DEDENT token generation, similar to Python's own tokenizer, and compiles the AST to Python code objects using the compiler module.

nodes.name: ylex.py
nodes.summary: PLY lexer for parsing YACC grammar specification files. Tokenizes YACC sections (definitions, rules), handles C code blocks enclosed in braces, and manages lexer state transitions between code and grammar sections.
nodes.languageNotes: Demonstrates PLY lexer states to switch between normal tokenization and C code block tokenization within YACC specifications.

nodes.name: yparse.py
nodes.summary: PLY parser grammar for converting YACC specification files into PLY-compatible Python code. Parses YACC definitions sections (tokens, types, precedence, union) and grammar rules, emitting equivalent PLY parser function definitions with embedded action code.
nodes.languageNotes: Meta-parser that parses YACC grammar specifications and generates PLY-compatible Python parser code as output.

nodes.name: yply.py
nodes.summary: Entry point script that converts a UNIX YACC specification file into a PLY-compatible Python parser specification. Accepts an optional -nocode flag to discard embedded C code from the generated output.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package initialization for the PLY (Python Lex-Yacc) library. Declares the package version (3.9) and exports the lex and yacc module names for public use.

nodes.name: BasicInterpreter
nodes.summary: Core runtime interpreter for Dartmouth BASIC programs. Handles statement execution, variable management, control flow (FOR loops, IF/GOTO), subroutines, expressions, and built-in math functions.

nodes.name: p_program
nodes.summary: Top-level grammar rule for a BASIC program. Groups numbered statements into an ordered dictionary keyed by line number, separating the program preamble from subsequent statements.

nodes.name: p_variable
nodes.summary: Grammar rule for BASIC variable references, supporting both simple scalar variables and array subscripts with single or double dimensions.

nodes.name: track_tokens_filter
nodes.summary: Lexer filter that tracks line and column number information for tokens. Wraps tokens with positional metadata for use in error reporting and debugging.

nodes.name: indentation_filter
nodes.summary: Lexer filter implementing Python-style indentation handling. Generates INDENT tokens when indentation increases and DEDENT tokens when it decreases, raising IndentationError on inconsistent indentation.

nodes.name: filter
nodes.summary: Composes the token tracking and indentation filters into a pipeline for use by the IndentLexer. Adds an optional ENDMARKER token at end of input.

nodes.name: Assign
nodes.summary: Creates AST assignment nodes for the GardenSnake parser. Handles both simple variable assignments and tuple unpacking assignments, raising SyntaxError on invalid left-hand sides.

nodes.name: p_file_input
nodes.summary: Top-level grammar rule for a GardenSnake source file. Builds the AST Module node from the parsed statement list, handling both single-statement and multi-statement inputs.

nodes.name: p_comparison
nodes.summary: Grammar rule for comparison expressions supporting less-than, greater-than, and equality operators. Built using factory functions that create AST Compare nodes.

nodes.name: p_power
nodes.summary: Grammar rule for function call expressions with positional arguments. Constructs AST CallFunc nodes from the atom and its argument list trailer.

nodes.name: p_testlist
nodes.summary: Grammar rule for expression lists in GardenSnake. Constructs AST Tuple nodes from comma-separated expressions, handling single-element edge cases.

nodes.name: dommatrix.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the DOMMatrix interface for mutable 2D/3D transformation matrices in the Servo DOM, extending DOMMatrixReadOnly with methods that mutate the matrix in place. Provides a full WebIDL binding with constructors from strings, sequences, and typed arrays, as well as mutating transform operations (translate, scale, rotate, skew, invert) and serialization support.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust DOM struct with #[dom_struct] attribute; inherits from DOMMatrixReadOnly via a parent field pattern used in Servo's DOM implementation.

nodes.name: dommatrixreadonly.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the DOMMatrixReadOnly interface for immutable 2D/3D transformation matrices. Stores a Transform3D matrix and an is2D flag, provides all getter properties (m11-m44, a-f), non-mutating transform computations (translate, scale, rotate, skew, inverse, flip), string serialization, and the transform-to-matrix CSS parser used by both matrix types.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Servo's dom_struct and DomRefCell for interior mutability; validates and fixes up matrix initialization dictionaries per the Geometry Interfaces spec.

nodes.name: dompointreadonly.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the DOMPointReadOnly interface for immutable 2D/3D points. Stores x, y, z, w as Cell<f64> values, provides read accessors and a MatrixTransform method that applies a DOMMatrix to transform the point, returning a new DOMPoint. Also defines the DOMPointWriteMethods trait implemented by the mutable variant.

nodes.name: domquad.rs

nodes.languageNotes: Uses Dom<T> for DOM references to the four corner points and iterates them with nan_safe_minimum/nan_safe_maximum for bounds computation.
