nodes.summary: Returns the current page loading strategy (None, Eager, or Normal).

nodes.name: strict_file_interactability
nodes.summary: Returns whether strict file interactability mode is enabled.

nodes.name: user_prompt_handler
nodes.summary: Returns a reference to the current UserPromptHandler map.

nodes.name: pointer_ids
nodes.summary: Returns available pointer IDs by collecting IDs from the input state table that are not actively assigned.

nodes.name: create_session
nodes.summary: Creates a full WebDriver session including browsing context initialization, capabilities negotiation, and preference configuration.

nodes.name: PageLoadStrategy
nodes.summary: Enum defining page load strategy options: None (no wait), Eager (interactive ready), and Normal (full load).

nodes.name: WebDriverSession
nodes.summary: Struct representing an active WebDriver session with browsing context tracking, timeout configuration, input state, and user prompt handler.

nodes.name: timeout.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the TimeoutsConfiguration struct and serialization logic for WebDriver script, page load, and implicit wait timeout settings following the W3C specification.

nodes.name: user_prompt.rs
nodes.summary: Handles WebDriver user prompts (alert, confirm, prompt dialogs) with configurable prompt handler behaviors including dismiss, accept, and text input operations. Implements the unhandled prompt behavior deserialization per the W3C spec.

nodes.name: deserialize_as_timeouts_configuration
nodes.summary: Deserializes JSON timeout values into a TimeoutsConfiguration struct, supporting script, pageLoad, and implicit keys per W3C spec.

nodes.name: serialize_timeouts_configuration
nodes.summary: Serializes a TimeoutsConfiguration to a JSON object with script, pageLoad, and implicit fields.

nodes.name: TimeoutsConfiguration
nodes.summary: Struct holding WebDriver timeout values for script execution, page loading, implicit wait, and sleep interval.

nodes.name: deserialize_unhandled_prompt_behaviour
nodes.summary: Deserializes an unhandled prompt behavior configuration value into a UserPromptHandler map per W3C spec, supporting string or object formats.

nodes.name: default_unhandled_prompt_behavior
nodes.summary: Returns the default user prompt handler configuration mapping all prompt types to 'dismiss and notify'.

nodes.name: get_user_prompt_handler
nodes.summary: Retrieves the configured prompt handler action for a given prompt type from the session, with default fallback.

nodes.name: handle_dismiss_alert
nodes.summary: Handles the DismissAlert command by sending a dismiss action to the embedder for the current user prompt.

nodes.name: handle_accept_alert
nodes.summary: Handles the AcceptAlert command by sending an accept action to the embedder for the current user prompt.

nodes.name: handle_get_alert_text
nodes.summary: Handles the GetAlertText command by retrieving the text of the current user prompt from the embedder.

nodes.name: handle_send_alert_text
nodes.summary: Handles the SendAlertText command by sending text input to the current user prompt with validation.

nodes.name: handle_any_user_prompts
nodes.summary: Checks for any pending user prompts and returns an error if present, used as a pre-condition guard for blocking commands.

nodes.name: PromptHandlerConfiguration
nodes.summary: Struct pairing a WebDriverUserPromptAction with a notify flag, representing a configured prompt handler entry.

nodes.name: ast.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the XPath abstract syntax tree (AST) data structures including expression types, binary operators, path expressions, XPath axes, node tests, kind tests, literals, and core function identifiers used across the XPath evaluation system.

nodes.name: Expression
nodes.summary: Core XPath expression AST enum with variants for binary operations, path expressions, location steps, filters, literals, variables, context items, and function calls.

nodes.name: BinaryOperator
nodes.summary: Enumeration of all XPath binary operators including boolean (or/and), set union, equality, relational, and arithmetic operators.

nodes.name: PathExpression
nodes.summary: XPath path expression consisting of an absolute/relative flag, an implicit descendant-or-self step indicator, and a sequence of location steps.

nodes.name: Axis
nodes.summary: Enumeration of all XPath axes including child, descendant, attribute, self, descendant-or-self, following-sibling, following, namespace, parent, ancestor, preceding-sibling, preceding, and ancestor-or-self.

nodes.name: CoreFunction
nodes.summary: Enumeration of all XPath 1.0 core functions including string, numeric, boolean, and node-set functions with associated argument expressions.

nodes.name: context.rs
nodes.summary: Defines evaluation context structures for XPath processing, including the root evaluation context with a context node and predicate-specific context tracking position and size within a predicate.

nodes.name: eval.rs
nodes.summary: Implements XPath expression evaluation logic including binary operations, path expressions with steps and axes, node test filtering, predicate application, and recursive descent through parsed AST nodes.

nodes.name: try_extract_nodeset
nodes.summary: Attempts to extract a NodeSet from a Value, returning an error if the value is not a nodeset.

nodes.name: Expression.evaluate
nodes.summary: Dispatches evaluation of an XPath Expression by matching its variant, handling binary operators, path expressions, location steps, filters, literals, variable references, context items, and function calls.

nodes.name: PathExpression.evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates a path expression by traversing steps from the context node or document root, computing the accumulated node set at each step with proper axis traversal.

nodes.name: element_name_test
nodes.summary: Compares an element's qualified name against an expected name with case-sensitive or case-insensitive comparison modes for XHTML vs HTML documents.

nodes.name: apply_node_test
nodes.summary: Applies a node test (name test or kind test) against a given DOM node to determine if it matches, handling elements, attributes, processing instructions, comments, and text nodes.

nodes.name: LocationStepExpression.evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates a location step by gathering candidate nodes from the specified axis, filtering them through the node test and predicate list, and returning the sorted result.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Applies predicate expressions to filter a matched node set, evaluating each predicate as boolean or positional numeric per XPath semantics.

nodes.name: FilterExpression.evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates a filter expression by first evaluating the inner expression, then applying predicate filters to the result set.

nodes.name: NameTestComparisonMode
nodes.summary: Enum controlling whether element name comparisons use case-sensitive (XHTML) or case-insensitive (HTML) matching, adapting XPath for HTML documents.

nodes.name: functions.rs
nodes.summary: Implements XPath 1.0 core library functions including string manipulation (substring, concat, normalize-space, translate), node introspection (local-name, name, namespace-uri), numeric operations (sum, floor, ceiling, round), boolean logic, and the lang() function.

nodes.name: substring
nodes.summary: Extracts a substring from a source string starting at a given 1-based position with an optional length, following XPath 1.0 substring semantics with character indexing.

nodes.name: normalize_space
nodes.summary: Normalizes whitespace by trimming leading and trailing whitespace and collapsing internal runs of whitespace characters into single spaces.

nodes.name: lang_matches
nodes.summary: Determines if a context language matches or is a sublanguage of a target language per XPath lang() semantics with case-insensitive comparison.

nodes.name: translate
nodes.summary: Performs character-by-character translation on an input string, replacing characters from the 'from' set with corresponding characters in the 'to' set.

nodes.name: CoreFunction.evaluate
nodes.summary: Dispatches XPath core function evaluation by matching the CoreFunction variant to the appropriate implementation, handling all 27 XPath 1.0 core functions.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the generic DOM abstraction traits (Node, Element, Attribute, Document, ProcessingInstruction, NamespaceResolver) that decouple XPath evaluation from any specific DOM implementation, plus the evaluate_parsed_xpath entry point and helper functions for name validation.

nodes.name: evaluate_parsed_xpath
nodes.summary: Entry point for evaluating a parsed XPath expression against a context node, returning a deduplicated and sorted NodeSet.

nodes.name: is_valid_start
nodes.summary: Checks if a character is valid as the start of an XML NCName per XPath tokenization rules, accepting letters, underscore, and colon.

nodes.name: is_valid_continuation
nodes.summary: Checks if a character is valid as a continuation character within an XML NCName, extending isValidStart with digits, hyphens, and dots.

nodes.name: Node
nodes.summary: Trait defining the abstract DOM node interface with methods for tree navigation (parent, children, ancestors, siblings), type checking, text content access, and document order comparison required by XPath evaluation.

nodes.name: Element
nodes.summary: Trait defining the abstract DOM element interface with methods for accessing qualified names, namespace URIs, local names, attributes, and HTML document detection.

nodes.name: Attribute
nodes.summary: Trait defining the abstract DOM attribute interface with methods for accessing prefix, namespace, and local name of an attribute node.

nodes.name: Error
nodes.summary: Error enum for XPath evaluation failures including invalid nodeset access, variable usage in unsupported contexts, invalid qualified names, and internal errors.

nodes.name: parser.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the XPath expression parser using recursive descent, transforming tokenized input into the AST representation with support for binary expressions, path expressions, step expressions with axes and node tests, function calls, and predicates.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements Pratt-style precedence climbing for binary operator parsing, and recursive descent for XPath grammar constructs.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Public entry point that creates a Parser from input string and namespace resolver, parses a single expression, and verifies no trailing input remains.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new Parser instance by tokenizing the input string and configuring the namespace resolver and HTML document flag.

nodes.name: resolve_qualified_name
nodes.summary: Resolves a namespace prefix to its full namespace URI using the registered namespace resolver for qualified name construction.

nodes.name: parse_expression
nodes.summary: Parses a top-level XPath expression with operator precedence using the Pratt parsing approach, handling negation and function call prefixes.

nodes.name: parse_union_expression
nodes.summary: Parses a union expression combining two path expressions with the | operator.

nodes.name: parse_path_expression
nodes.summary: Parses an absolute or relative path expression consisting of slash-separated location steps, handling both / and // shorthand.

nodes.name: parse_filter_or_step_expression
nodes.summary: Parses a primary expression including parenthesized expressions, function calls, numeric and string literals, variable references, and location steps.

nodes.name: parse_step_expression
nodes.summary: Parses a full location step including optional axis specifier, node test (name test or kind test with arguments), and predicate list.

nodes.name: parse_node_test
nodes.summary: Parses a node test including kind tests (comment, text, processing-instruction, node) with optional PI target argument, and wildcard name tests.

nodes.name: parse_predicates
nodes.summary: Parses a sequence of predicate expressions enclosed in brackets used to filter node sets.

nodes.name: parse_function_call
nodes.summary: Parses a function call expression by matching the function name against known XPath 1.0 core functions, validating argument counts, and constructing the appropriate CoreFunction variant.

nodes.name: create_binary_expression
nodes.summary: Constructs a binary expression node from left and right operands and an operator, wrapping the left operand in a negation node when the operator indicates subtraction.

nodes.name: Error
nodes.summary: Comprehensive error enum for XPath parsing failures covering tokenization errors, unknown functions, argument count mismatches, missing delimiters, and namespace resolution failures.

nodes.name: tokenizer.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the XPath expression tokenizer that converts raw XPath string input into typed token streams, handling NCName parsing, operator recognition, string and numeric literals, axis identifiers, and whitespace handling.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-pass tokenization with operator context tracking to disambiguate '-' between subtraction and name characters.

nodes.name: consume_ncname
nodes.summary: Consumes an XML NCName from the remaining input using XPath name validation rules, optionally allowing wildcards, and returns the consumed segment and remainder.

nodes.name: consume_single_token
nodes.summary: Main token dispatch that consumes the next single token from input, handling variable references, qualified names, operators, axes, punctuation, and character-based tokens with operator context awareness.

nodes.name: consume_numeric_literal
nodes.summary: Parses a numeric literal (integer or decimal) from the remaining input, handling digit sequences and optional decimal points with fallback to zero on parse failure.

nodes.name: match_operator_name
nodes.summary: Matches a name string against known XPath operator names (and, or, mod, div) for contextual operator recognition during tokenization.

nodes.name: precedence
nodes.summary: Returns the operator precedence level for an OperatorToken, used by the parser's Pratt-style expression parsing to determine binding strength.

nodes.name: is_start_of_location_step
nodes.summary: Determines if the current token position starts a location step, distinguishing path expressions from arithmetic division by examining surrounding context.

nodes.name: followed_by_operator
nodes.summary: Checks if the current token is followed by an operator in the input to disambiguate the hyphen-minus character as subtraction versus a name character.

nodes.name: tokenize
nodes.summary: Main tokenization entry point that converts an XPath string input into a vector of tokens, tracking operator context for correct token classification between expressions.

nodes.name: Error
nodes.summary: Error enum for tokenizer failures including invalid variable references, invalid NCNames, unterminated string literals, and illegal characters.

nodes.name: OperatorToken
nodes.summary: Enum of all XPath operator types including and, or, multiply, modulo, divide, add, subtract, comparison, and equality operators.

nodes.name: Token
nodes.summary: Comprehensive enum of all XPath token types including variable references, qualified names, operators, literals, axis identifiers, punctuation, and node type tests.

nodes.name: value.rs
nodes.summary: Implements XPath runtime value types including the Value enum (Boolean, Number, String, NodeSet) and NodeSet collection with document-order sorting, deduplication, type conversion methods, and equality comparison logic per XPath 1.0 semantics.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements XPath equality comparison with heterogeneous type promotion (boolean, number, string, nodeset) and XPath-specific numeric conversion with NaN/Infinity handling.

nodes.name: deduplicate
nodes.summary: Removes duplicate nodes from the NodeSet using opaque node identifiers, preserving the first occurrence of each unique node.

nodes.name: parse_number_from_string
nodes.summary: Parses a trimmed string as a floating-point number, returning NaN for unparseable input per XPath number() semantics.

nodes.name: eq
nodes.summary: Performs XPath value equality comparison across different types (boolean, number, string, nodeset) following XPath 1.0 comparison rules with type promotion.

nodes.name: convert_to_boolean
nodes.summary: Converts a Value to boolean per XPath rules: false for empty nodeset, zero or NaN number, and empty string; true for all other values.

nodes.name: convert_to_number
nodes.summary: Converts a Value to a number per XPath rules: true becomes 1, false becomes 0, strings are parsed, nodesets use the first node's string value then parse.

nodes.name: convert_to_string
nodes.summary: Converts a Value to a string per XPath rules: boolean to true/false, number with Infinity/NaN/zero formatting, node set to first node's text content, string returns itself.

nodes.name: backend.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the GenericDrawTarget trait and Convert trait that form the abstract drawing interface for all canvas backends, with method signatures derived from Servo's legacy Azure backend.

nodes.name: GenericDrawTarget
nodes.summary: Abstract trait defining the complete drawing surface API including fill, stroke, text rendering, clipping, shadows, and snapshot operations. Implemented by both GPU (Vello) and CPU (VelloCPU) backends.

nodes.name: Convert
nodes.summary: Conversion trait implemented by multiple types across the canvas module to convert between Servo's internal canvas types and peniko/vello rendering types.

nodes.name: canvas_data.rs
nodes.summary: Core canvas drawing data and operations layer that manages a draw target, provides all drawing primitives (rect, path, text, image, shadows, clipping), and handles image key management with the paint API.

nodes.name: CanvasData
nodes.summary: Core data structure holding a draw target, paint API reference, and optional image key. Acts as the central state holder for all canvas drawing operations.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new CanvasData with a draw target sized to the given dimensions, ensuring minimum image dimensions.

nodes.name: set_image_key
nodes.summary: Replaces the image key associated with this canvas, registering the new image with the paint API and removing the old one.

nodes.name: draw_image
nodes.summary: Draws a snapshot image onto the canvas with optional source/dest rect clipping, smoothing, shadow effects, composition, and transform.

nodes.name: fill_text
nodes.summary: Fills text at the specified bounds using the given fill/stroke style, optional shadow, composition mode, and transform.

nodes.name: stroke_text
nodes.summary: Strokes text outlines using the specified style and line options, with shadow, composition, and transform support.

nodes.name: fill_rect
nodes.summary: Fills a rectangular area with optional shadow effects, composition blending, and transform. Handles zero-size gradient edge cases.

nodes.name: clear_rect
nodes.summary: Clears a rectangular area by delegating to the underlying draw target's clear_rect method.

nodes.name: stroke_rect
nodes.summary: Strokes a rectangular outline with line options, optional shadow effects, composition blending, and transform.

nodes.name: fill_path
nodes.summary: Fills a path using the specified fill rule and style, with shadow, composition, and transform support.

nodes.name: stroke_path
nodes.summary: Strokes a path using the specified style, line options, shadow, composition, and transform.

nodes.name: clip_path
nodes.summary: Pushes a path-based clip region onto the draw target's clip stack.

nodes.name: recreate
nodes.summary: Recreates the underlying draw target with a new size, preserving the paint API and re-applying image rendering settings.

nodes.name: update_image_rendering
nodes.summary: Updates the image rendered by the paint API from the current draw target state, keyed by the canvas epoch for synchronization.

nodes.name: put_image_data
nodes.summary: Writes raw image data into the draw target by creating a temporary surface and copying it into place.

nodes.name: read_pixels
nodes.summary: Reads pixel data from the draw target within a specified rectangle, returning a snapshot with proper bounds checking.

nodes.name: pop_clips
nodes.summary: Pops a specified number of clip regions from the draw target's clip stack.

nodes.name: write_image
nodes.summary: Helper function that draws a snapshot onto a draw target with smoothing, composition, and optional shadow effects, managing source surface creation and image placement.

nodes.name: canvas_paint_thread.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the Canvas paint thread that manages multiple canvas instances, processes commands from the constellation, and dispatches drawing operations to the appropriate backend (Vello GPU or Vello CPU).

nodes.name: CanvasPaintThread
nodes.summary: Main paint thread struct holding a map of active canvases, the next canvas ID counter, and the paint API reference. Spawns a dedicated OS thread for canvas message processing.

nodes.name: Canvas
nodes.summary: Enum dispatching drawing operations to either the Vello GPU backend or the Vello CPU backend, wrapping a CanvasData instance for each variant.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Spawns the canvas paint thread, setting up message receivers for canvas commands and constellation-level messages (create/exit), then enters the message loop.

nodes.name: create_canvas
nodes.summary: Creates a new Canvas instance with the specified size, inserts it into the canvas map, and returns the assigned CanvasId.

nodes.name: process_command
nodes.summary: Main command dispatcher that processes all canvas operations (resize, remove, set image key, fill/stroke text/rect/path, clip, draw image, read/write pixels) by delegating to the target canvas's methods.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new Canvas instance selecting the Vello or VelloCPU backend based on the dom_canvas_backend preference.

nodes.name: stroke_text
nodes.summary: Dispatches stroke text operation to the active backend's CanvasData with shadow, composition, and transform parameters.

nodes.name: fill_text
nodes.summary: Dispatches fill text operation to the active backend's CanvasData with shadow, composition, and transform parameters.

nodes.name: fill_rect
nodes.summary: Dispatches fill rect operation to the active backend's CanvasData with style, shadow, composition, and transform parameters.

nodes.name: stroke_rect
nodes.summary: Dispatches stroke rect operation to the active backend's CanvasData with line options, shadow, composition, and transform parameters.

nodes.name: fill_path
nodes.summary: Dispatches fill path operation to the active backend's CanvasData with fill rule, style, shadow, composition, and transform parameters.

nodes.name: stroke_path
nodes.summary: Dispatches stroke path operation to the active backend's CanvasData with line options, style, shadow, composition, and transform parameters.

nodes.name: draw_image
nodes.summary: Dispatches draw image operation to the active backend's CanvasData with source/dest rects, smoothing, shadow, composition, and transform.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the canvas component that declares all submodules (backend, canvas_data, canvas_paint_thread, peniko_conversions, vello_backend, vello_cpu_backend) and exposes the public canvas_data and canvas_paint_thread modules.

nodes.name: peniko_conversions.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the Convert trait across multiple types to translate Servo's canvas internal types (colors, gradients, line options, brushes, images) into peniko and kurbo equivalents used by the Vello rendering pipeline.

nodes.name: convert
nodes.summary: Implements Convert for 16 different type pairs including FontData, Color, CompositionStyle, LineOptions, FillOrStrokeStyle, ColorStops, and snapshot-to-image conversions, bridging Servo canvas types to peniko rendering types.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust trait implementation with multiple impl blocks for different source/target type pairs, all named convert via method dispatch.

nodes.name: vello_backend.rs
nodes.summary: GPU-accelerated canvas drawing backend using the Vello renderer with wgpu. Implements GenericDrawTarget with scene graph composition, texture-based rendering, font caching, and GPU readback for snapshots.

nodes.name: VelloDrawTarget
nodes.summary: GPU-backed draw target using Vello's scene graph renderer with wgpu. Manages device resources, render textures, buffer readback, and provides the full drawing API for canvas operations.

nodes.name: State
nodes.summary: Enum tracking the render state machine transitions: Drawing, RenderedToTexture, and RenderedToBuffer, ensuring proper resource lifecycle for GPU operations.

nodes.name: new_with_renderer
nodes.summary: Constructs a VelloDrawTarget from an existing wgpu device, queue, and renderer, setting up render textures, buffers, and default scene state.

nodes.name: with_composition
nodes.summary: Wraps a drawing operation in a scene layer that applies composition or blending effects via push/pop layer on the Vello scene.

nodes.name: ignore_clips
nodes.summary: Temporarily removes clip layers before executing a function, then restores them, used for full-canvas operations like clear and copy.

nodes.name: is_viewport_cleared
nodes.summary: Checks whether a clear rect with transform covers the full viewport by testing against clip bounds.

nodes.name: ensure_drawing
nodes.summary: Transitions the state to Drawing and initializes the scene with a transparent clear fill, ensuring the draw target is ready for new operations.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a fully initialized VelloDrawTarget by discovering a wgpu device, creating a renderer, and setting up all GPU resources with fallback backend selection.

nodes.name: clear_rect
nodes.summary: Clears a rectangular region by either resetting the entire scene (full viewport) or drawing a solid fill rect with clear composition.

nodes.name: copy_surface
nodes.summary: Copies a surface (image buffer) to the draw target at a specified destination with optional source rect, handling alpha premultiplication and transform.

nodes.name: draw_surface
nodes.summary: Draws a surface onto the canvas with composition blending, image filter, and transform, creating a peniko image from the source data.

nodes.name: draw_surface_with_shadow
nodes.summary: Stub implementation for drawing a surface with shadow effects - currently panics as shadow rendering is not yet supported in the Vello backend.

nodes.name: fill
nodes.summary: Fills a path on the scene graph with the given style and composition, converting fill rules and transforms to peniko types.

nodes.name: fill_text
nodes.summary: Fills text glyphs onto the scene graph by looking up fonts from a thread-local cache, converting font data to peniko, and drawing glyphs with the specified brush.

nodes.name: fill_rect
nodes.summary: Fills a rectangle on the scene graph using the converted brush style with composition and transform.

nodes.name: push_clip_rect
nodes.summary: Pushes a rectangular clip region by creating a path from the rect and delegating to push_clip with identity transform.

nodes.name: stroke
nodes.summary: Strokes a path on the scene graph with line options, brush style, composition, and transform.

nodes.name: stroke_text
nodes.summary: Strokes text glyphs on the scene graph with line options, font cache lookup, and brush style, converting font data to peniko format.

nodes.name: stroke_rect
nodes.summary: Strokes a rectangle outline on the scene graph with line options, brush, composition, and transform.

nodes.name: image_descriptor_and_serializable_data
nodes.summary: Reads back the rendered buffer via GPU map_read and produces an image descriptor with serializable pixel data for transfer to the compositor.

nodes.name: snapshot
nodes.summary: Captures the current rendered state by mapping the GPU buffer and converting it into a Snapshot, removing row padding for the unpadded pixel data.

nodes.name: render_to_texture
nodes.summary: Renders the Vello scene graph to a GPU texture via wgpu, applying antialiasing and resetting the scene for subsequent drawing operations.

nodes.name: render_to_buffer
nodes.summary: Renders the scene to a GPU texture then copies the texture to a staging buffer for CPU readback, coordinating the GPU copy and queue submission.

nodes.name: map_read
nodes.summary: Maps the GPU staging buffer for reading, using oneshot channel signaling to synchronize the async map_async operation, then runs a provided closure on the mapped range.

nodes.name: vello_cpu_backend.rs
nodes.summary: CPU-based canvas drawing backend using the vello_cpu rasterizer. Implements GenericDrawTarget with software rendering, pixmap management, font caching, and snapshot generation for systems without GPU support.

nodes.name: VelloCPUDrawTarget
nodes.summary: CPU-powered draw target using vello_cpu's software renderer with pixmap backing. Provides the full GenericDrawTarget API through CPU-based scene composition and rasterization.

nodes.name: State
nodes.summary: Enum tracking render state: Drawing or Rendered, ensuring correct resource lifecycle for CPU rasterization.

nodes.name: with_composition
nodes.summary: Wraps a drawing operation in a blend layer using vello_cpu's push/pop layer mechanism for composition and blending effects.

nodes.name: ignore_clips
nodes.summary: Temporarily removes clip layers for full-canvas operations by saving/restoring the clip stack around a function call.

nodes.name: ensure_drawing
nodes.summary: Transitions state to Drawing, clears the pixmap with a transparent fill, and prepares the CPU render context for new operations.

nodes.name: pixmap
nodes.summary: Renders the current CPU scene to the pixmap, flushes pending operations, then returns a byte slice of the rendered pixel data.

nodes.name: is_viewport_cleared
nodes.summary: Checks whether a clear rect covers the full viewport by testing against clip bounds, using bezier path bounding boxes for clip intersection.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new VelloCPUDrawTarget with a sized pixmap, CPU render context, and resource manager.

nodes.name: clear_rect
nodes.summary: Clears a rectangular region by resetting the scene for full viewport or drawing a filled clip path with clear blending.

nodes.name: copy_surface
nodes.summary: Copies a surface to the draw target using CPU pixel operations with transform and image source setup via vello_cpu.

nodes.name: draw_surface
nodes.summary: Draws a surface onto the canvas with alpha premultiplication, composition, paint transform, and image filtering via vello_cpu.

nodes.name: draw_surface_with_shadow
nodes.summary: Stub implementation for drawing surfaces with shadow - currently panics as shadow rendering is not yet supported in the CPU backend.

nodes.name: fill
nodes.summary: Fills a path on the CPU render context with fill rule, brush paint, transform, and composition.

nodes.name: fill_text
nodes.summary: Fills text glyphs using vello_cpu's glyph_run API with font cache lookup, brush paint, composition effects, and transform.

nodes.name: fill_rect
nodes.summary: Fills a rectangle on the CPU render context with brush paint, transform, and composition.

nodes.name: push_clip_rect
nodes.summary: Pushes a rectangular clip by creating a path from the rect and delegating to push_clip with identity transform.

nodes.name: stroke
nodes.summary: Strokes a path on the CPU render context with line options, brush paint, transform, and composition.

nodes.name: stroke_text
nodes.summary: Strokes text glyphs using vello_cpu's glyph_run with stroke API, font cache, brush paint, line options, composition, and transform.

nodes.name: stroke_rect
nodes.summary: Strokes a rectangle outline on the CPU render context with line options, brush paint, transform, and composition.

nodes.name: image_descriptor_and_serializable_data
nodes.summary: Produces an image descriptor and serializable pixel data from the rendered pixmap for transfer to the compositor.

nodes.name: snapshot
nodes.summary: Captures the current rendered pixmap as a Snapshot with proper size and pixel data.

nodes.name: snapshot_as_pixmap
nodes.summary: Converts a pixel Snapshot into a vello_cpu Pixmap by applying alpha premultiplication and casting pixel data.

nodes.name: convert
nodes.summary: Implements Convert for FillOrStrokeStyle to vello_cpu PaintType, handling solid colors, linear/radial gradients, and image brushes.

nodes.name: paint
nodes.summary: Converts a FillOrStrokeStyle with alpha multiplier to a vello_cpu PaintType, handling alpha blending for solid colors, gradients, and images.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel file that publicly re-exports all submodules in the security directory: csp, csppolicyviolationreport, cspviolationreporttask, sanitizer, securitypolicyviolationevent, and xframeoptions.

nodes.name: csppolicyviolationreport.rs
nodes.summary: Data structures and builders for CSP violation reports, including SecurityPolicyViolationReport, CSPReportUriViolationReportBody, CSPReportUriViolationReport, and the CSPViolationReportBuilder with serialization support.

nodes.name: sanitizer.rs
nodes.summary: HTML Sanitizer API implementation providing DOM node sanitization with configurable element allow/remove lists, attribute filtering, processing instruction handling, and built-in safe configurations.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the W3C Sanitizer API specification with extensive use of enums for element/attribute representations and recursive tree traversal for sanitization.

nodes.name: securitypolicyviolationevent.rs
nodes.summary: DOM SecurityPolicyViolationEvent implementation providing the event type dispatched when a CSP violation occurs, with properties for document URI, referrer, blocked URI, directives, and disposition.

nodes.name: xframeoptions.rs

nodes.languageNotes: Uses unsafe shared state via a static UncheckedSyncUnsafeCell with semaphore-based synchronization between the sampling thread and signal handler.

nodes.name: sampler_mac.rs
nodes.summary: macOS implementation of the Sampler trait using Mach kernel APIs (thread_suspend, thread_get_state) for suspending threads and frame pointer stack walking for unwinding.

nodes.name: sampler_windows.rs
nodes.summary: Windows implementation of the Sampler trait with a placeholder stub that returns Err(()), containing TODO markers for SuspendThread and GetThreadContext integration.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Initializes the background hang monitor worker thread and returns a HangMonitorRegister handle for registering components.

nodes.name: register_component
nodes.summary: Registers a new monitored component with hang timeouts and exit signal, returning a BackgroundHangMonitorChan for sending activity notifications.

nodes.name: BackgroundHangMonitorChan::new
nodes.summary: Creates a new BackgroundHangMonitorChan that wraps an IPC sender for a specific component.

nodes.name: BackgroundHangMonitorWorker::new
nodes.summary: Constructs the BackgroundHangMonitorWorker with channels, control port routing, and timing baselines for sampling and hang detection.

nodes.name: BackgroundHangMonitorWorker::finish_sampled_profile
nodes.summary: Serializes accumulated samples into a JSON profile and sends it to the constellation via a HangMonitorAlert::Profile message.

nodes.name: BackgroundHangMonitorWorker::run
nodes.summary: Main event loop that processes IPC messages, performs sampling at intervals, runs hang detection checkpoints, and handles component timeouts.

nodes.name: BackgroundHangMonitorWorker::handle_msg
nodes.summary: Dispatches incoming MonitoredComponentMsg variants: Register, Unregister, NotifyActivity, and NotifyWait for component lifecycle management.

nodes.name: BackgroundHangMonitorWorker::perform_a_hang_monitor_checkpoint
nodes.summary: Checks all monitored components for transient and permanent hangs by comparing elapsed time against configured timeouts, then sends hang alerts.

nodes.name: BackgroundHangMonitorWorker::sample
nodes.summary: Captures native stack samples from all monitored components using the platform sampler and stores them in a circular buffer.

nodes.name: HangMonitorRegister
nodes.summary: Public handle returned to callers for registering components with the background hang monitor and spawning the monitoring worker thread.

nodes.name: BackgroundHangMonitorWorker
nodes.summary: Core worker struct that manages the main event loop, hang detection checkpoints, sampled profiling, and component lifecycle tracking.

nodes.name: process_register
nodes.summary: Records an instruction pointer and stack pointer pair into the NativeStack buffer, returning an error if the maximum frame count is exceeded.

nodes.name: to_hangprofile
nodes.summary: Converts a NativeStack into a HangProfile by resolving instruction pointers to symbol names, demangling Rust symbols, and extracting filenames and line numbers.

nodes.name: Sampler
nodes.summary: Trait defining the interface for platform-specific thread suspension and native stack sampling, with a single method suspend_and_sample_thread.

nodes.name: NativeStack
nodes.summary: Fixed-capacity buffer storing instruction pointers and stack pointers collected from a suspended thread, with methods for register processing and HangProfile conversion.

nodes.name: clear_shared_state
nodes.summary: Resets the three POSIX semaphores (msg2, msg3, msg4) in the global shared state to their uninitialized state.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new PosixSemaphore wrapping a libc sem_t, initialized with a given value, using MaybeUninit for zero-cost construction.

nodes.name: wait_through_intr
nodes.summary: Retries the semaphore wait operation when interrupted by a signal (EINTR), yielding the thread between retries.

nodes.name: LinuxSampler::default
nodes.summary: Creates a LinuxSampler by resolving the target thread ID via syscall, installing a SIGPROF signal handler via sigaction, and storing the old handler for cleanup.

nodes.name: suspend_and_sample_thread
nodes.summary: Implements the Sampler trait method for Linux: sends SIGPROF to the target thread, collects native stack frames via backtrace::trace_unsynchronized using semaphore-based handshake synchronization.

nodes.name: sigprof_handler
nodes.summary: SIGPROF signal handler that synchronizes with the sampling thread via semaphore handshake (msg2 post, msg3 wait, msg4 post) to safely collect register state.

nodes.name: PosixSemaphore
nodes.summary: Safe Rust wrapper around a libc sem_t with methods for creation, posting, waiting, and cleanup, providing semaphore-based synchronization for thread sampling.

nodes.name: LinuxSampler
nodes.summary: Linux implementation of the Sampler trait that uses SIGPROF signals and semaphore-based handshake protocols to suspend and sample target threads.

nodes.name: MacOsSampler::suspend_and_sample_thread
nodes.summary: Implements the Sampler trait for macOS: suspends the target thread via Mach APIs, gets register state, walks the stack via frame pointers, and resumes the thread.

nodes.name: get_registers
nodes.summary: Retrieves thread register state (instruction pointer, stack pointer, frame pointer) via Mach thread_get_state, supporting both x86_64 and ARM64 architectures.

nodes.name: frame_pointer_stack_walk
nodes.summary: Walks the native stack using frame pointer chaining, validating addresses against the thread's stack bounds, and recording instruction/stack pointers.

nodes.name: MacOsSampler
nodes.summary: macOS implementation of the Sampler trait using Mach kernel thread APIs for suspending and sampling threads.

nodes.name: suspend_and_sample_thread
nodes.summary: Stub implementation of the Sampler trait for Windows that returns Err(()) with TODO markers for SuspendThread, GetThreadContext, and ResumeThread integration.

nodes.name: WindowsSampler
nodes.summary: Stub Windows implementation of the Sampler trait with a placeholder thread_id field and unimplemented suspend_and_sample_thread method.

nodes.name: actor.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the actor system for the Mozilla Remote Protocol (Chrome DevTools Protocol), including the ActorRegistry for managing registered actors, message routing between actors and client connections, and script/source actor lifecycle management.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses RwLock-based interior mutability pattern for thread-safe actor registry, with trait-based Actor abstraction for polymorphic message dispatch.

nodes.name: ActorError
nodes.summary: Enum representing error replies in the DevTools protocol, including missing parameters, bad parameter types, unrecognized packet types, and internal errors.

nodes.name: name
nodes.summary: Returns the human-readable name for an ActorError variant, matching Firefox DevTools error packet conventions.

nodes.name: base_name
nodes.summary: Extracts the simple type name from a fully-qualified Rust type path by splitting on '::' and taking the last segment.

nodes.name: new_actor_name
nodes.summary: Generates a unique actor name combining the base type name with an incrementing counter, ensuring uniqueness within the actor registry.

nodes.name: Actor
nodes.summary: Trait defining the core actor interface with methods for name, message handling, and cleanup, used by all DevTools protocol actors.

nodes.name: ActorAsAny
nodes.summary: Trait for downcasting Actor trait objects to Any, enabling type-safe downcasting of registered actors.

nodes.name: ActorEncode
nodes.summary: Trait for encoding actors to serializable values, used to send actor state through the DevTools protocol.

nodes.name: DowncastableActorArc
nodes.summary: Wrapper around Arc<dyn Actor> that provides downcasting support to access concrete actor types, using PhantomData for type safety.

nodes.name: deref
nodes.summary: Deref implementation for DowncastableActorArc that attempts to downcast the inner actor to the target type T.

nodes.name: RegisteredActor
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper around DowncastableActorArc providing Eq, Hash, Borrow, and MallocSizeOf implementations via delegation, used as keys in the actor registry's internal HashMap.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Acquires a write lock on the ActorRegistry, using a reentrancy guard to detect and prevent recursive write lock attempts.

nodes.name: ActorRegistry
nodes.summary: The central registry managing all DevTools actors, providing methods for registration, lookup, message forwarding, script/actor binding, and cleanup by stream.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers an actor in the registry by wrapping it in a RegisteredActor and inserting it into the actors map.

nodes.name: find
nodes.summary: Looks up a registered actor by name, downcasts it to the requested type T, and panics if not found or type mismatch.

nodes.name: encode
nodes.summary: Finds an actor by name and encodes it to a serializable JSON value for transmission over the DevTools protocol.

nodes.name: handle_message
nodes.summary: Routes incoming JSON messages to the appropriate actor, handling 'to' field resolution, type-based packet dispatch, and forwarding to ClientRequest for synchronous replies.

nodes.name: register_script_actor
nodes.summary: Binds a script ID to an actor name in both directions (script-to-actor and actor-to-script), enabling bidirectional lookup.

nodes.name: script_to_actor
nodes.summary: Resolves a script ID to its registered actor name, panicking with a descriptive error if no actor is found.

nodes.name: script_actor_registered
nodes.summary: Checks whether a script ID already has an actor registered, returning a boolean.

nodes.name: actor_to_script
nodes.summary: Resolves an actor name to its registered script ID, panicking with a descriptive error if no mapping exists.

nodes.name: register_source_actor
nodes.summary: Associates a source actor name with a pipeline ID for tracking source content by pipeline.

nodes.name: source_actor_names_for_pipeline
nodes.summary: Retrieves all source actor names registered for a given pipeline ID.

nodes.name: set_inline_source_content
nodes.summary: Stores inline source content for a pipeline ID, supporting conditional update only when new content is provided.

nodes.name: inline_source_content
nodes.summary: Retrieves previously stored inline source content for a given pipeline ID.

nodes.name: cleanup
nodes.summary: Removes all registered actors associated with a given stream ID, calling each actor's cleanup method before removal.

nodes.name: id.rs
nodes.summary: Provides ID mapping between Servo internal identifiers (WebView, BrowsingContext, Pipeline) and DevTools-specific numeric IDs for the remote debugging protocol.

nodes.name: IdMap
nodes.summary: Manages bidirectional mappings between Servo internal IDs and DevTools API IDs for browser instances, browsing contexts, and outer windows.

nodes.name: browser_id
nodes.summary: Maps a Servo WebView ID to a DevTools browser ID, creating a new sequential ID on first encounter.

nodes.name: browsing_context_id
nodes.summary: Maps a Servo BrowsingContext ID to a DevTools browsing context ID, creating a new sequential ID with overflow safety.

nodes.name: outer_window_id
nodes.summary: Maps a Servo Pipeline ID to a DevTools outer window ID, creating a new sequential ID with overflow checking.

nodes.name: DevtoolsBrowserId
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper around u32 representing a DevTools browser identifier.

nodes.name: DevtoolsBrowsingContextId
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper around u32 representing a DevTools browsing context identifier.

nodes.name: DevtoolsOuterWindowId
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper around u32 representing a DevTools outer window identifier.

nodes.name: value
nodes.summary: Returns the inner u32 value of DevtoolsBrowserId.

nodes.name: value
nodes.summary: Returns the inner u32 value of DevtoolsBrowsingContextId.

nodes.name: value
nodes.summary: Returns the inner u32 value of DevtoolsOuterWindowId.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the devtools library, implementing a remote DevTools protocol server that manages client connections, actor lifecycle, and event dispatch for navigation, console, DOM mutations, network, and debugger events.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a thread-based concurrency model with one thread for the listener acceptor and separate threads per client handler, communicating via crossbeam channels.

nodes.name: EmptyReplyMsg
nodes.summary: Minimal response message struct with only a 'from' field, used for replies that carry no additional data.

nodes.name: ActorMsg
nodes.summary: Enum wrapper for actor-related DevTools control messages, allowing generic message dispatch through the actor registry.

nodes.name: start_server
nodes.summary: Public entry point that spawns the DevTools server thread with memory profiling support, creating a DevtoolsInstance and running its event loop.

nodes.name: StreamId
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper around u32 providing unique identifiers for client streams, used to track connections during cleanup.

nodes.name: DevtoolsInstance
nodes.summary: Core state holder for the DevTools server, containing the actor registry, ID map, browsing context tracking, client connections, and message channel for receiving control messages from other components.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Constructs a DevtoolsInstance by binding a TCP listener, registering the RootActor, setting up ID mappings and connection tracking, and spawning the client acceptor thread.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Main event loop that processes incoming DevtoolsControlMsg variants, dispatching to the appropriate handler methods for navigation, console, DOM, network, debugger, and framerate events.

nodes.name: handle_navigate
nodes.summary: Handles page navigation events: updates browsing context actor pipeline info, emits will-navigate and target-available/destroyed notifications to watcher actors, and updates all open connections.

nodes.name: handle_new_global
nodes.summary: Handles creation of new global execution contexts (documents or workers): registers actors, maps IDs, creates browsing context actors, and manages worker thread tracking.

nodes.name: handle_title_changed
nodes.summary: Forwards page title change events to the associated browsing context actor for display in DevTools.

nodes.name: handle_console_resource
nodes.summary: Routes console resource messages (log entries, page errors) to the appropriate console actor and pushes them to all connected clients.

nodes.name: handle_dom_mutation
nodes.summary: Processes DOM mutation events by forwarding them through the browsing context, inspector, and walker actors to all connected clients.

nodes.name: handle_clear_console
nodes.summary: Sends a console clear message to the appropriate console actor, broadcasting to all open client connections.

nodes.name: find_console_actor
nodes.summary: Resolves the correct console actor name for a given pipeline and optional worker ID, searching worker actors or browsing contexts as appropriate.

nodes.name: handle_network_event
nodes.summary: Coordinates network event processing by looking up or creating network event actors and delegating detailed event handling to the network handler module.

nodes.name: create_network_event_actor
nodes.summary: Creates and registers a new NetworkEventActor, storing its name in the actor_requests map for later lookup.

nodes.name: handle_create_source_actor
nodes.summary: Creates and registers source actors for JavaScript source files, managing source content retrieval and attaching sources to thread or browsing context managers.

nodes.name: handle_update_source_content
nodes.summary: Updates the content of a source actor by name, falling back to inline source content storage when needed.

nodes.name: handle_debugger_pause
nodes.summary: Handles debugger pause events by creating a PauseActor, setting frame offsets, and sending paused notifications to the connected client.

nodes.name: handle_create_frame_actor
nodes.summary: Creates frame actors for stack frames during debugger pauses, looking up source actors and registering them in a thread-scoped manager.

nodes.name: handle_create_environment_actor
nodes.summary: Creates or updates environment actors for debugger scope representations, sending the actor name back to the caller via a result channel.

nodes.name: allow_devtools_client
nodes.summary: Verifies whether an incoming TCP connection should be accepted by peeking at the first bytes for authentication and requesting embedder approval via an allow/deny token exchange.

nodes.name: handle_client
nodes.summary: Handles an individual DevTools client connection: performs initial RootActor encoding handshake, then reads and dispatches JSON packets until connection closure or error.

nodes.name: debugger_value_to_json
nodes.summary: Converts DebuggerValue types to serde_json::Value representations, handling undefined, null, uninitialized, boolean, NaN, infinity, negative zero, numeric, string, and object values with preview support.

nodes.name: network_handler.rs
nodes.summary: Handles network event dispatching for the DevTools protocol, processing request, response, and security info updates by emitting resource-available notifications through the WatcherActor.

nodes.name: Cause
nodes.summary: Represents the cause of a network request, with a type field and optional loading document URI, serialized in camelCase for the DevTools protocol.

nodes.name: handle_network_event
nodes.summary: Dispatches network event updates to connected clients by looking up the NetworkEventActor, encoding event state, and pushing resource-available/updated notifications through the WatcherActor for each event phase (request, response, security info).

nodes.name: protocol.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the DevTools remote protocol transport layer including JSON packet reading and writing over TCP streams, the DevtoolsConnection wrapper with length-prefixed packets, and ClientRequest for actor command handling with reply validation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a custom length-prefixed JSON framing format (length:data) similar to the Firefox DevTools wire protocol.

nodes.name: ActorDescription
nodes.summary: Describes a protocol actor with category, type name, and supported methods, used for introspection by DevTools clients.

nodes.name: Method
nodes.summary: Describes an actor method with name, request schema, and response schema for DevTools protocol introspection.

nodes.name: JsonPacketStream
nodes.summary: Trait defining the JSON packet stream interface with read/write methods for DevTools protocol communication over TCP.

nodes.name: DevtoolsConnection
nodes.summary: Thread-safe wrapper around a TCP stream providing JSON packet read/write, peer address lookup, and shutdown capabilities with Mutex-guarded access.

nodes.name: peer_addr
nodes.summary: Returns the peer socket address of the DevTools connection.

nodes.name: shutdown
nodes.summary: Shuts down the TCP connection in the specified direction (read, write, or both).

nodes.name: read_json_packet
nodes.summary: Reads a length-prefixed JSON packet from the TCP stream using the DevTools wire format, handling partial reads and malformed packets with descriptive errors.

nodes.name: ClientRequest
nodes.summary: Represents an individual client request from the DevTools protocol, tracking the stream, actor target, and whether it has been handled.

nodes.name: handle
nodes.summary: Processes a client request by invoking the handler function with the JSON message, returning Ok/Err based on handler result and preventing multiple handling.

nodes.name: reply
nodes.summary: Sends a reply JSON packet back to the client over the associated stream connection.

nodes.name: reply_final
nodes.summary: Sends a final reply packet and marks the request as handled, terminating the request-response exchange.

nodes.name: mark_handled
nodes.summary: Marks the client request as having been handled, preventing duplicate processing.

nodes.name: stream
nodes.summary: Returns a clone of the underlying DevtoolsConnection stream for use in continuation handlers.

nodes.name: resource.rs
nodes.summary: Defines resource tracking types for the DevTools protocol, including resource array types (Available/Updated), the ResourceAvailableReply response structure, and the ResourceAvailable trait for broadcasting resource notifications.

nodes.name: ResourceArrayType
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing between resource types: Available (newly available resources) and Updated (previously available resources with updates).

nodes.name: ResourceAvailableReply
nodes.summary: Response struct for resource availability messages, containing the sender actor name, message type, and an array of (resource type, resources) tuples.

nodes.name: ResourceAvailable
nodes.summary: Trait providing methods for actors to broadcast resource availability and updates to connected clients via the JSON packet stream.

nodes.name: new

nodes.name: feed
nodes.summary: Feeds input data to the background parser thread and processes results including script execution and encoding detection responses.

nodes.name: end
nodes.summary: Signals end of input to the parser thread and processes pending operations.

nodes.name: url
nodes.summary: Returns the URL of the document being parsed.

nodes.name: set_plaintext_state

nodes.name: get_current_line

nodes.name: process_operation

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Main loop running on the parser background thread, receiving input chunks, driving the html5ever tokenizer and tree builder, and sending results back to the main thread.

nodes.name: append
nodes.summary: Appends a node or text as the last child of a given parent node.

nodes.name: get_template_contents
nodes.summary: Retrieves the DocumentFragment contents of an HTMLTemplateElement for use as the insertion point.

nodes.name: create_element
nodes.summary: Creates a DOM element from parser tokens with the given name, attributes, and flags, including custom element support.

nodes.name: associate_with_form
nodes.summary: Associates form-associated elements with their form owner during parser-inserted element processing.

nodes.name: append_before_sibling
nodes.summary: Sink method to insert a child before a sibling node in the tree, used by the tree construction algorithm.

nodes.name: append_based_on_parent_node
nodes.summary: Appends a child to its parent, handling form-association for elements inserted during tree construction.

nodes.name: append_doctype_to_document
nodes.summary: Creates and appends a DocumentType node to the document during tree construction.

nodes.name: add_attrs_if_missing
nodes.summary: Adds attributes to an element only if they are not already present, used for duplicate attribute handling during tree construction.

nodes.name: attach_declarative_shadow
nodes.summary: Attaches a declarative shadow root to a template element during tree construction, handling the serialized form parse.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new NetworkDecoderState in the Detecting phase with optional encoding hints from content-type and container document.

nodes.name: push
nodes.summary: Pushes a chunk of bytes into the decoder, transitioning from detecting to decoding once encoding is determined.

nodes.name: finish

nodes.name: is_finished

nodes.name: decoder

nodes.name: prescan_the_byte_stream_to_determine_the_encoding
nodes.summary: Implements the HTML Standard byte stream prescan algorithm that scans for encoding hints from meta charset declarations.

nodes.name: get_xml_encoding
nodes.summary: Extracts encoding from XML declaration in the byte stream.

nodes.name: get_an_attribute
nodes.summary: Parses an attribute from the byte stream during encoding prescan, handling quoted and unquoted attribute values.

nodes.name: extract_a_character_encoding_from_a_meta_element
nodes.summary: Extracts the character encoding from a parsed meta element's attributes during byte stream prescan.

nodes.name: determine_the_character_encoding
nodes.summary: Implements the HTML Standard encoding determination algorithm, trying BOM sniffing, prescanning, XML declaration, and chardetng fallback in sequence.

nodes.name: buffer
nodes.summary: Buffers incoming bytes and triggers encoding determination with timeout-based heuristics.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new synchronous HTML tokenizer, initializing html5ever's tokenizer and tree builder with fragment or full document parsing support.

nodes.name: feed
nodes.summary: Feeds input to the synchronous HTML tokenizer and returns results including script handles or encoding indicators.

nodes.name: end
nodes.summary: Signals end of input to the synchronous tokenizer.

nodes.name: url
nodes.summary: Returns the URL of the document being parsed synchronously.

nodes.name: set_plaintext_state
nodes.summary: Sets the synchronous parser to plaintext state.

nodes.name: get_current_line
nodes.summary: Returns the current line number from the synchronous parser.

nodes.name: serialize_html_fragment
nodes.summary: Serializes a DOM node to HTML markup, supporting shadow DOM serialization and configurable traversal scope.

nodes.name: serialize
nodes.summary: Implements the serialization trait for HtmlSerialize delegating to serialize_html_fragment.

nodes.name: start_element
nodes.summary: Serializes an element opening tag including namespace handling and self-closing syntax for void elements.

nodes.name: handle_node_contents
nodes.summary: Pushes serialization commands for a node's children, handling shadow root contents when enabled.

nodes.name: next

nodes.summary: Creates a new synchronous XML tokenizer, initializing the xml5 tokenizer and tree builder.

nodes.name: mod.rs

nodes.name: trustedhtml.rs

nodes.name: trustedscripturl.rs

nodes.name: trustedtypepolicy.rs

nodes.name: TrustedScriptURL

nodes.name: get_trusted_type_compliant_string
nodes.summary: Validates and extracts a trusted script URL string from input, delegating to TrustedTypePolicyFactory for policy enforcement when the input is a plain string.

nodes.name: data

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand what Servo is: a prototype web browser engine written in Rust, designed for parallelism from the ground up. The README documents platform support (macOS, Linux, Windows, Android, OpenHarmony), the build system based on `./mach build`, and links to detailed documentation. This is the entry point for anyone approaching the codebase, giving context for the architectural tour ahead.

tour.title: Workspace Architecture
tour.description: The root Cargo.toml defines the workspace structure: 9 workspace members including the binary shell (`ports/servoshell`), the core engine (`components/servo`), and specialized crates for layout, scripting, networking, fonts, paint, WebGL, and WebGPU. With over 260 dependencies, this manifest reveals the project's modular architecture: each component is a separate Rust crate with clear responsibility boundaries, making the codebase navigable despite its size.

tour.title: Application Shell Entry Point
tour.description: Execution begins in the servoshell crate. `lib.rs` serves as the crate root, re-exporting all platform modules and providing the application's main function. `desktop/cli.rs` parses command-line arguments, initializes crash handling, and launches the appropriate platform backend (headed or headless). This is where the `main()` function lives, bootstrapping the entire browser process.
tour.languageLesson: In Rust projects, `lib.rs` is the crate root that declares all public modules via `pub mod` and re-exports types with `pub use`. The absence of a `main.rs` in this crate indicates it is structured as a library with a binary entry point declared via Cargo.toml's `[[bin]]` section pointing to the CLI module.

tour.title: Application Lifecycle and Window Management
tour.description: Building on the CLI bootstrap, `desktop/app.rs` manages the core application lifecycle: initialization of the Servo engine, platform window creation, and event loop pumping. `window.rs` abstracts the platform window, containing one or more webviews that render web content. Together they form the bridge between the native platform (winit for windowing, Gilrs for gamepad input) and the Servo engine core.

tour.title: Core Engine and Embedder API
tour.description: Dropping down from the shell into the engine, `components/servo/servo.rs` implements the core embedder API: initialization, event loop dispatch, and message handling between the embedder, constellation, and script threads. `components/servo/lib.rs` re-exports all engine modules including clipboard, gamepad, JavaScript evaluation, network management, and WebView delegates. This crate is the bridge between the platform shell and Servo's internal architecture.
tour.languageLesson: Servo's embedder API uses Rust traits to define interfaces between components. The `Embedder` and `EmbedderProxy` traits abstract platform-specific behavior, allowing the same engine core to run on desktop, Android, and OpenHarmony without code changes.

tour.title: Browser Process Orchestration
tour.description: The constellation is Servo's central orchestrator, managing the lifecycle of browsing contexts, navigation, and pipeline creation. Written in `components/constellation/constellation.rs`, it coordinates communication between the script thread (DOM/JS), layout thread, and renderer via IPC, handling page navigation, iframe management, and sandboxing. With a fan-in of 116 (one of the highest in the codebase), it is one of the most depended-upon modules in the system.

tour.title: Cross-Process Communication Types
tour.description: `components/shared/embedder/lib.rs` defines the data types that cross process boundaries between the embedding application, the rendering pipeline, and the script engine. These types form the contract between Servo's multi-process architecture: embedder messages, pipeline initialization parameters, navigation requests, and rendering updates. Understanding this crate is essential for grasping how Servo's parallel process model communicates.

tour.title: Script Execution and the DOM
tour.description: The script crate is Servo's largest component, implementing the full Web IDL DOM specification. `components/script/lib.rs` establishes the crate structure, while `components/script/script_thread.rs` (fan-in of 49) is the main script execution thread coordinating page loads, rendering updates, timers, and WebDriver commands via IPC with the constellation. `components/script/dom/mod.rs` declares all DOM binding submodules (elements, events, canvas, fetch, WebGL, WebXR, and more), forming the interface between JavaScript and the browser engine.
tour.languageLesson: Rust's `unsafe` blocks are used extensively in the script crate to interoperate with SpiderMonkey (Firefox's JavaScript engine) via FFI. DOM objects use reference counting (`DomRefCell`, `DomRoot`) that mirrors the Web IDL specification's ownership model while maintaining memory safety.

tour.title: Layout Engine
tour.description: The layout crate converts the DOM tree and computed CSS styles into positioned boxes and fragments. `components/layout/lib.rs` is the crate root defining core types like `ContainingBlock` and re-exporting all layout modules. `components/layout/flow/mod.rs` implements the core flow module with box and fragment base types, traversal state, and formatting context plumbing for inline, block, float, flexbox, and table layouts. This is where CSS layout rules are translated into concrete geometry.
tour.languageLesson: Rust's enum-based type system is used to represent CSS display types (block, inline, flex, etc.) as a strongly-typed `FlowType` enum with associated data per variant. Pattern matching on this enum drives the layout algorithm's dispatch without dynamic dispatch overhead.

tour.title: Rendering and Compositing Pipeline
tour.description: Once layout computes box positions, the rendering pipeline converts the fragment tree into a display list of paint commands. `components/layout/display_list/mod.rs` builds the display list by walking the fragment tree and producing WebRender display items (backgrounds, borders, text, images, gradients). `components/paint/lib.rs` bootstraps the paint state and coordinates with WebRender for GPU-accelerated compositing. This pipeline transforms structured layout into the pixels users see on screen.

tour.title: Networking Layer
tour.description: The networking layer handles HTTP requests, cookie management, caching, and resource loading for the entire browser. `components/net/lib.rs` re-exports all networking submodules including HTTP loading, caching, cookie management, WebSocket support, and MIME type sniffing. `components/shared/net/lib.rs` provides the core types for HTTP requests/responses, fetch infrastructure, and cookie management that are shared across process boundaries. This crate is what enables the browser to actually retrieve web content from the network.
